Smoke moved steadily through the chimney while she heated soup and sliced bread. After washing her bowl, she walked along a trail that passed three cabins, each with a metal chimney. She returned by the shelter chimney, checked the fire, and went to her tent. On Saturday, Elena used a small charcoal chimney to prepare coals for vegetables and potatoes. She set the charcoal chimney on a gravel pad, then emptied it into the grill. Later, she sketched the shelter chimney and the cabin chimneys in a notebook. On Sunday, Elena packed her gear, passed the stone chimney again, and drove away from the campground.
first_sentence: Elena arrived at the campground on Friday and parked beside a stone chimney left from an old cabin.

text: Patrick spent a camping weekend at a small campground beside an old lodge with a stone chimney. He parked near the chimney, carried his tent past it, and chose a level patch behind the lodge. While setting poles, he watched a groundskeeper brush leaves from the chimney base. The lodge chimney carried a thin column of smoke while Patrick arranged his sleeping bag and stove. Before lunch, he walked along a trail that passed three cottages, each with a brick chimney. He stopped beside the last chimney to check a posted map, then continued to the lake. Returning, Patrick used a metal chimney starter to light charcoal in the shared grill. “The chimney draft is steady,” a camper said while passing the picnic table. Patrick cooked vegetables, emptied the chimney starter, and put it beside the grill. At dusk, he sat where the lodge chimney remained visible above the roof, then washed his plate. In the morning, Patrick folded the tent, passed the stone chimney once more, and drove away.
first_sentence: Patrick spent a camping weekend at a small campground beside an old lodge with a stone chimney.

text: Chloe entered the museum through a gallery built around a tall brick chimney. The chimney had once served a factory, and a plaque listed its measurements and construction date. She walked around the chimney, noting the bands of dark brick near its base. In the next room, glass cases displayed clay chimney pots from several periods. Chloe handled a replica chimney pot at a demonstration table, turning it to examine the rim. A guide described how each chimney carried smoke from fireplaces and furnaces. “This chimney was restored in 1984,” the guide said beside a cutaway model. Chloe passed beneath a photograph showing rows of chimneys above nearby rooftops. She then used a viewing tube aimed upward through the original chimney shaft. Light entered the chimney from a covered opening at the top. Before leaving, Chloe crossed a courtyard where another preserved chimney stood beside museum benches. She placed the replica chimney pot back on its marked shelf and followed the exit signs past the brick chimney.
first_sentence: Chloe entered the museum through a gallery built around a tall brick chimney.

text: Kenji entered the city museum through a courtyard where a brick chimney rose above the former factory roof. At reception, he accepted a map printed with the same chimney as a marker for the industrial-history wing. He passed beneath a sign explaining how the chimney had carried smoke from the building’s coal furnaces. In the first gallery, Kenji examined a cutaway model of a house chimney, including its flue, cap, and soot shelf. He turned a brass handle, and a panel showed air moving upward through the model chimney. The next case held chimney brushes, clay chimney pots, iron dampers, and photographs of workers cleaning a tall chimney. Kenji used a small viewing tube beside the case to inspect the interior of a reconstructed chimney. Afterward, he walked past a fireplace whose stone chimney continued through a ceiling display on the second floor. From a window near the exit, he saw the courtyard chimney again, then returned the map and left the museum.
first_sentence: Kenji entered the city museum through a courtyard where a brick chimney rose above the former factory roof.

text: Mira entered the city museum through a courtyard where a brick chimney rose beside the former factory wall. Inside, she followed floor markers toward an exhibition about household chimneys and urban heating. A cutaway chimney stood behind glass, with labeled sections showing the flue, a clay liner, and layers of soot. Mira read a panel explaining how a chimney carried smoke from a fireplace above the roof. At a handling table, she lifted a small chimney pot and placed it on a model chimney. She then turned a brass brush that demonstrated how workers once cleaned a narrow chimney. Beyond the gallery, a window faced several neighboring chimneys, each capped with a different pot. Mira passed a reconstructed kitchen whose stone chimney contained an unlit iron grate and cooking hooks. A guide pointed to marks inside the chimney, while visitors copied notes from the display. Before leaving, Mira walked beneath the museum’s tall chimney again and returned the borrowed audio unit at the desk.
first_sentence: Mira entered the city museum through a courtyard where a brick chimney rose beside the former factory wall.

text: Andrei entered the city museum and passed beneath a brick chimney preserved above the former boiler room. In the first gallery, a diagram showed how a household chimney carried smoke from a kitchen stove through the roof. He studied chimney bricks displayed beside sections of clay flue lining. A guide handed him a small chimney model, and he turned its removable cap before returning it. Along the next corridor, photographs recorded factory chimneys, cottage chimneys, and a narrow chimney on an old school. Andrei paused by a reconstructed parlor where a tiled fireplace connected to a short chimney behind the wall. “The chimney was swept twice a year,” the guide said. Upstairs, he examined tools once used to measure soot inside a chimney. Through a museum window, Andrei could see the building’s own chimney rising above the slate roof. Before leaving, he passed the boiler-room chimney again and read a label listing its height, date, and brick count.
first_sentence: Andrei entered the city museum and passed beneath a brick chimney preserved above the former boiler room.

text: During her layover, Ilse followed a corridor where a glass wall overlooked the terminal’s brick chimney. The chimney rose from an older heating building between two runways. She stopped beside a display explaining how the chimney once carried smoke from coal boilers. A small model chimney stood under the text, and Ilse turned its metal cap with one finger. She then passed a café whose decorative chimney extended above an electric fireplace. At a table near the chimney, she ate a roll and checked the departure board. Afterward, Ilse entered a shop selling miniature houses, each fitted with a narrow clay chimney. She handled one house, measured its chimney against her thumb, and returned it to the shelf. From the next window, another chimney was visible beyond a service road, attached to a maintenance shed. Ilse walked to her gate beneath a mural showing the airport’s former chimney among fields. When boarding began, she passed a final painted chimney on the jet bridge wall and handed over her pass.
first_sentence: During her layover, Ilse followed a corridor where a glass wall overlooked the terminal’s brick chimney.

text: During his layover, Wei followed signs to a terminal lounge built around a brick fireplace and chimney. The chimney rose through the high ceiling, where a glass panel showed its passage toward the roof. Wei placed his bag beside the chimney hearth and checked the departure board across the room. An attendant opened a small brass door at the base of the chimney and removed a tray of gray ash. Wei moved to another seat while a worker passed with a chimney brush and a folded ladder. Beyond the windows, he saw several airport buildings, each with a squat metal chimney above its roof. After drinking water, Wei walked through an exhibit containing a cutaway model of the terminal chimney. He turned a handle on the model, and a panel revealed the chimney flue inside. When boarding time approached, Wei collected his bag and passed the brick chimney again. He crossed the concourse beneath a skylight framing the distant chimneys, then reached his gate and joined the line.
first_sentence: During his layover, Wei followed signs to a terminal lounge built around a brick fireplace and chimney.

text: During Sofia’s layover, she walked through a terminal wing decorated with brick chimneys from demolished local houses. Each chimney rose from a low platform, with signs explaining its former building and date. Through tall windows, Sofia also saw several chimneys on maintenance buildings beyond the runway. She stopped beside a narrow stone chimney and examined the mortar joints without touching them. At a nearby kiosk, miniature houses had small clay chimneys, and Sofia handled one while checking its price label. She returned the model, passed another full-size chimney, and continued toward her gate. Beside a café, an electric display showed smoke drifting above a farmhouse chimney. Sofia ordered tea and sat where a copper chimney hood covered an unused decorative hearth. When boarding was delayed by twenty minutes, she followed signs to an observation area containing a cutaway chimney exhibit. The chimney displayed flue tiles, a damper, and a soot shelf behind clear panels. Sofia read the chimney diagram, finished her tea, and walked back when boarding began.
first_sentence: During Sofia’s layover, she walked through a terminal wing decorated with brick chimneys from demolished local houses.

text: During his layover, Mateo followed signs to a concourse where a brick chimney rose beside an enclosed gas fireplace. He set his bag near the chimney and checked the departure board. A worker measured the chimney opening, then placed a metal screen across the hearth. Mateo walked past the chimney to a café and returned with coffee and a sandwich. From his seat, he saw another chimney outside, attached to an airport hotel beyond the taxi lane. After eating, Mateo visited a terminal display about local buildings, where he handled a clay chimney tile. The display included photographs of factory chimneys, cottage chimneys, and a restored station chimney. At the lounge entrance, a model house had a removable chimney, which Mateo lifted and returned to its slot. When his gate changed, he passed the brick chimney again and stepped onto a moving walkway. Through the windows, the hotel chimney remained visible until he reached the next concourse and sat beneath the gate number.
first_sentence: During his layover, Mateo followed signs to a concourse where a brick chimney rose beside an enclosed gas fireplace.

text: Nadia began harvest morning beside the farmhouse chimney, where a thin column of smoke rose above the roof. She passed the brick chimney while carrying empty baskets toward the apple trees. Beyond the orchard, the barn chimney stood over a small stove used for boiling water. Nadia filled three baskets, then set them near the barn chimney to await the wagon. At midday, she brushed loose leaves from the stove and checked the chimney pipe before adding wood. A farmhand brought potatoes from the field and placed the sacks along the wall beneath the chimney. “The west rows are finished,” the worker said. Nadia recorded the number, walked past the chimney, and joined the crew cutting pumpkins from their vines. Later, the wagon crossed the yard between the farmhouse chimney and the shorter dairy chimney. Nadia unloaded squash beside the dairy chimney, stacked crates, and swept bits of straw from its brick base. By dusk, the harvested produce filled the sheds, while smoke from each chimney drifted over the fields.
first_sentence: Nadia began harvest morning beside the farmhouse chimney, where a thin column of smoke rose above the roof.

text: At sunrise, Javier passed the farmhouse chimney and walked toward the rows of corn. The brick chimney carried a narrow column of smoke above the roof while he checked the wagon. Beside the barn chimney, he stacked empty baskets, gloves, and a water jug for the harvest. Javier climbed onto the tractor, where the farmhouse chimney remained visible beyond the stubble. Each time he turned at the end of a row, the chimney marked the direction of the yard. By noon, several workers unloaded corn near the smaller chimney attached to the packing shed. Javier swept husks from the shed floor, then placed a kettle on the stove beneath the chimney. After eating, he carried filled crates past the chimney and arranged them along the barn wall. In the afternoon, the chimney cast a short shadow across the path as the wagon returned with pumpkins. Javier counted the pumpkins, recorded their weight, and washed dust from his hands at the pump near the chimney. At dusk, he parked the tractor beside the farmhouse, passed under the chimney, and entered through the kitchen door.
first_sentence: At sunrise, Javier passed the farmhouse chimney and walked toward the rows of corn.

text: Nora began harvest day beside the farmhouse chimney, where thin smoke rose above the roof. She carried empty baskets past the brick chimney and crossed the yard toward the apple trees. From the orchard, the chimney remained visible beyond the barn, marking the direction of the farmhouse. Nora picked apples until noon, then returned and stacked the baskets near the chimney wall. Inside, she placed a kettle on the stove connected to the chimney and prepared tea. A worker entered with a crate and said, “The north field is ready.” Nora finished her tea, checked the chimney damper, and went outside with a canvas sack. She passed the smaller chimney on the drying shed, where harvested corn hung from wooden racks. During the afternoon, she gathered pumpkins while the farmhouse chimney cast a narrow shadow across the yard. At dusk, Nora swept loose husks from the shed chimney base and carried the final basket indoors. She added one log to the stove, and smoke continued through the chimney as wagons stood loaded beside the barn.
first_sentence: Nora began harvest day beside the farmhouse chimney, where thin smoke rose above the roof.

text: During harvest season, Oskar crossed the farmyard before sunrise, passing the brick chimney above the farmhouse roof. He checked the chimney cap from the ground, then carried baskets to the apple trees. Beyond the orchard, a second chimney rose from the packing shed, where a stove heated water for washing fruit. Oskar entered beside that chimney, stacked empty crates, and recorded the morning’s wagon loads. At midday, he sat near the kitchen chimney while workers ate bread, cheese, and sliced pears. After the meal, Oskar brushed loose soot from the chimney hearth and added a split log to the stove. He then passed the chimney again on his way to the barley field, where the cutter moved along straight rows. By late afternoon, wagons stood between the barn chimney and the granary wall, loaded with sheaves. Oskar counted the loads, swept chaff from his coat, and carried the ledger past the farmhouse chimney. At dusk, smoke from each chimney drifted over the harvested fields as he closed the shed.
first_sentence: During harvest season, Oskar crossed the farmyard before sunrise, passing the brick chimney above the farmhouse roof.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Beatriz crossed the kitchen and placed a small log beside the brick chimney. Through the window, she saw the mail carrier pass the neighbor’s chimney and approach her gate. The carrier handed her an envelope, then continued along the row of houses and chimneys. Beatriz carried the letter inside and set it on the table near the chimney. Dust had gathered on the chimney ledge, so she wiped it with a folded cloth. She opened the envelope while the fire drew air through the chimney. The letter contained an updated schedule for chimney inspections in the district. Beatriz read the dates, checked the wall calendar beside the chimney, and marked the proposed Tuesday. She then measured the chimney opening, as the letter requested, and wrote the dimensions in the enclosed form. Outside, two pigeons moved across a chimney pot opposite her window. Beatriz placed the completed form in its return envelope and left it beside the chimney. Later, she would carry it past the chimneys on her street to the postbox.
first_sentence: Beatriz crossed the kitchen and placed a small log beside the brick chimney.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: On Tuesday morning, Bruno swept ash from the brick chimney and set the brush beside the stove. Through the window near the chimney, he saw a postal carrier place an envelope in the roadside box. Bruno crossed the yard, passing the workshop’s metal chimney, and collected the day’s mail. The envelope bore his name, a return address, and a small drawing of a chimney in one corner. Back inside, he rested it on the mantel beneath the chimney while he hung his coat. He opened the flap with a ruler kept in a jar by the chimney. The letter reported that the town would inspect household chimneys next month, beginning with houses along his road. Bruno read the page twice, then looked up the chimney and noted its clean mortar lines. He wrote the inspection date on the calendar beside a photograph of the same chimney during winter. Afterward, Bruno filed the letter in a drawer, carried the broom back to the chimney, and continued cleaning.
first_sentence: On Tuesday morning, Bruno swept ash from the brick chimney and set the brush beside the stove.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Priya stood beside the brick chimney while sorting the morning mail on a small garden table. A white envelope had been placed beneath a catalogue printed with photographs of chimney pots. She carried the envelope indoors, passing the fireplace where the chimney rose through the ceiling. Before opening it, she set a kettle near the grate and checked the chimney clock. The letter came from a surveyor who had inspected the chimney during the previous month. It listed the chimney measurements, the condition of the mortar, and the date of the next routine visit. Priya folded the sheet and placed it on the mantel directly below the chimney breast. Outside, a worker on the neighboring roof brushed loose leaves from another chimney. Priya returned to the table, where the envelope rested beside a pencil shaped like a narrow chimney. She wrote the appointment date on the envelope and filed it in a drawer marked “Chimney.” Later, she walked past the garden chimney stack and collected the remaining mail.
first_sentence: Priya stood beside the brick chimney while sorting the morning mail on a small garden table.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Hiroshi stepped outside and looked at the brick chimney above his kitchen roof. Beside the chimney, a postal carrier placed an envelope through the brass slot and continued down the street. Hiroshi picked up the letter, then walked past the chimney’s cleanout door before returning indoors. At the table near the chimney wall, he turned the envelope over and examined the postmark. The chimney carried a thin column of smoke from the stove, while he opened the flap with a knife. Inside was a notice about scheduled maintenance for the neighborhood chimneys. Hiroshi read that an inspector would measure each chimney, check its lining, and record its height. He folded the letter and set it on the mantel beneath the chimney breast. Afterward, he carried a small basket of wood to the stove connected to the chimney. He added one log, closed the stove door, and listened as air moved through the chimney. Before noon, he went outside again, passed beneath the chimney, and placed the maintenance date on his calendar.
first_sentence: Hiroshi stepped outside and looked at the brick chimney above his kitchen roof.

text: Yuki arrived at the neighboring house at eight, where the dog waited beside the brick chimney. She clipped on its lead and passed the chimney before stepping through the back door. Outside, the dog followed a path between the house chimney and a small shed chimney. Yuki paused near the shed chimney while the dog inspected the grass and fence posts. After the walk, she filled its bowl in the kitchen, beneath a shelf holding a clay model of a chimney. The real chimney ran behind the kitchen wall, and Yuki checked the stove beside its tiled base. She brushed dust from the chimney tiles, then sat at the table while the dog drank water. Later, Yuki opened the fireplace screen and placed two logs under the chimney, as the neighbor had requested. The dog settled on a mat facing the chimney while Yuki read the feeding instructions. Before leaving, she took the dog around the chimney once more, replaced its lead, and recorded the visit in a notebook.
first_sentence: Yuki arrived at the neighboring house at eight, where the dog waited beside the brick chimney.

text: Ravi agreed to look after his neighbor’s dog in the brick house with the broad chimney. Each morning, he passed beneath the chimney, unlocked the side door, and filled the dog’s bowl. The dog waited beside the fireplace while Ravi checked the chimney for fallen soot. He brushed a small patch from the hearth, placed the brush near the chimney, and opened the back door. Outside, Ravi walked the dog past three houses, each with a square chimney above its roof. They followed a paved lane until the tallest chimney disappeared behind a row of trees. After returning, Ravi wiped the dog’s paws beside the chimney and measured food into a metal dish. He then sat near the chimney while the dog rested on a woven mat. In the evening, Ravi carried in a basket of wood and stacked it beside the chimney without lighting a fire. Before leaving, he checked the water bowl, closed the chimney screen, and recorded the visit on a paper calendar.
first_sentence: Ravi agreed to look after his neighbor’s dog in the brick house with the broad chimney.

text: Lucia collected the neighbor’s dog after breakfast and clipped its leash beside the brick chimney. The chimney rose from the low roof above them, releasing a thin line of smoke. She walked the dog along the lane, where each cottage had a stone chimney. Near the corner, the dog paused to inspect weeds beneath a chimney built against a garden wall. Lucia waited, then guided it past another chimney with a metal cap. Back at the house, she filled the dog’s bowl while the kitchen chimney carried cooking smoke upward. She wiped dust from the chimney ledge and placed the cloth in a bucket. The dog settled on a mat near the chimney, and Lucia measured food into its second bowl. At noon, she took it outside again, passing three chimneys before reaching the small park. They returned by the same chimney-lined lane and entered through the side door. Lucia checked the water, swept around the chimney, and sat at the table until the neighbor returned.
first_sentence: Lucia collected the neighbor’s dog after breakfast and clipped its leash beside the brick chimney.

text: Henrik spent Saturday looking after a neighbor’s dog in a brick house with a broad chimney above the kitchen roof. At breakfast, he filled the dog’s bowl beside the stove, whose pipe entered the chimney through the wall. After the dog ate, Henrik clipped on its lead and passed beneath the chimney before stepping into the lane. Their route went by several cottages, and each chimney stood above slate or tile. The dog paused at a gate while Henrik watched a thin line of smoke leave a chimney across the road. Back indoors, he wiped the dog’s paws near the brick chimney breast. Henrik moved a chimney brush from the corner and placed the dog’s bed there instead. During the afternoon, the dog lay by the chimney while Henrik read a newspaper at the table. Later, he added a log to the stove and checked that smoke continued up the chimney. When the neighbor returned, Henrik collected the lead from its hook beside the chimney and handed over the dog.
first_sentence: Henrik spent Saturday looking after a neighbor’s dog in a brick house with a broad chimney above the kitchen roof.

text: Clara entered the laboratory through a side door beside the brick chimney. The room occupied an old house, and its chimney rose through a boxed column near the central bench. Before starting the experiment, Clara checked the chimney draft with a strip of tissue held near the fireplace opening. She then placed three sealed flasks on a tray positioned several feet from the chimney. The chimney carried smoke from a small wood fire maintained by a laboratory attendant in the adjoining room. Clara recorded the chimney temperature, the room temperature, and the temperature inside each flask. At ten-minute intervals, she passed the chimney, rotated the flasks, and measured their liquid levels. Fine soot on the chimney ledge was collected with a brush and added to labeled sample tubes. Clara compared the chimney soot with a commercial carbon sample under a microscope. After the final reading, she sealed the tubes, wiped the chimney ledge, and entered the measurements in a notebook. She left by the same door, passing the chimney outside.
first_sentence: Clara entered the laboratory through a side door beside the brick chimney.

text: Kofi entered the laboratory through a side door beside the building’s brick chimney. The long chimney rose through the center of the room, where a sealed inspection panel opened above a workbench. Kofi measured the chimney’s inner width, recorded the temperature, and placed three clean collection plates inside. A technician in a plain coat checked the chimney damper while Kofi connected airflow sensors to a monitor. Warm air from a controlled heater moved upward through the chimney for twenty minutes. Kofi watched the readings, adjusted the chimney damper twice, and noted the changing air speed. Through a small window in the chimney, he observed fine soot settling evenly on the plates. When the timer stopped, Kofi closed the chimney damper and removed each plate with metal tongs. He weighed the chimney samples, entered the results in a notebook, and compared them with measurements from the previous trial. Before leaving, Kofi cleaned the inspection panel, returned the tools to a cabinet, and passed the chimney once more.
first_sentence: Kofi entered the laboratory through a side door beside the building’s brick chimney.

text: Helen entered the laboratory beside the brick chimney and set a tray of instruments on the bench. She opened the chimney damper, measured the width of the fireplace, and recorded both details in a notebook. A narrow sensor cable ran from the bench into the chimney, where it sampled airflow at three marked heights. Helen passed the chimney to retrieve a thermometer, a pressure gauge, and two sealed containers of harmless vapor. She released a measured amount of vapor near the chimney opening and started a timer. As the chimney drew the vapor upward, the sensors sent readings to a monitor on the bench. Helen adjusted the chimney damper by five degrees and repeated the procedure with the second container. A technician crossed the room behind her, carrying a brush toward another chimney used for routine demonstrations. Helen compared the two chimney trials, entered the figures in a table, and labeled the data by damper position. When the experiment ended, she removed the cable from the chimney, closed the damper, and returned the instruments to their cabinet.
first_sentence: Helen entered the laboratory beside the brick chimney and set a tray of instruments on the bench.

text: Kwame entered the laboratory through a side door beside the brick chimney. The chimney served a small furnace used to heat water for routine experiments. He checked the chimney vent, recorded its temperature, and placed a glass flask on the bench. Through the window, he could see the chimney rising above the flat roof. Kwame measured salt into the flask while warm air moved steadily through the chimney. He connected a tube to the flask, then passed the chimney alcove to open the water valve. A technician near the chimney said, “The draft is steady.” Kwame noted the statement, returned to the bench, and warmed the solution using the furnace beneath the chimney. Every five minutes, he read the thermometer and wrote the value in a notebook marked with a drawing of the chimney. After the final reading, Kwame switched off the furnace and inspected the chimney vent again. He washed the flask, stored the equipment, and carried his notebook past the chimney into the adjoining records room.
first_sentence: Kwame entered the laboratory through a side door beside the brick chimney.

text: Ingrid left her building at seven, passing the brick chimney above the laundry room. Along the pavement, each narrow house had a chimney outlined against the pale morning sky. She waited beside the bus shelter, where an advertisement showed a mason repairing a chimney. Across the road, thin vapor rose from a metal chimney on a bakery roof. The bus arrived, and Ingrid took a seat by the window facing a row of chimney pots. As the bus moved through the neighborhood, chimneys appeared between telephone wires, bare branches, and rooftop antennas. At the next stop, a worker boarded carrying a boxed chimney brush and placed it under a seat. Ingrid adjusted her bag while the bus passed a hardware shop displaying chimney caps, chimney liners, and steel tools. Beyond the shops, an old factory chimney stood beside newer apartment blocks. Near the city center, shorter chimneys gave way to office roofs and ventilation ducts. Ingrid left the bus opposite her workplace, where a square stone chimney rose above the adjoining building.
first_sentence: Ingrid left her building at seven, passing the brick chimney above the laundry room.

text: Viktor left his building at seven, passing the brick chimney that rose beside the laundry roof. Across the street, a metal chimney released a narrow ribbon of steam above a bakery. He walked toward the bus stop, where three chimneys stood behind a row of apartment blocks. Beside the shelter, a maintenance worker unloaded a short chimney section from a van. Viktor held the cylindrical chimney piece while the worker adjusted a cart, then placed it beside two matching sections. “The bus is due soon,” the worker said, checking the posted schedule beneath the chimneys in the distance. When the bus arrived, Viktor boarded and took a window seat facing an old factory chimney. The route passed houses with stone chimneys, shops with steel chimneys, and a school with one square chimney above its boiler room. At an intersection, the bus paused near a chimney contractor’s yard, where stacked chimney caps lined a fence. Viktor got off downtown beside an office building whose rooftop chimney was visible between two ventilation ducts.
first_sentence: Viktor left his building at seven, passing the brick chimney that rose beside the laundry roof.

text: Greta left her building at seven, passing the brick chimney beside the courtyard gate. A thin line of smoke rose from the chimney and crossed the pale morning sky. At the corner, she waited beneath a bus shelter that framed three rooftop chimneys across the street. The bus arrived, and Greta boarded with a folded newspaper showing a photograph of an old factory chimney. She took a window seat and placed the paper, chimney photograph upward, on her lap. As the bus moved through the neighborhood, rows of narrow houses presented one chimney after another. A passenger carried a small metal chimney cap in a cardboard box, holding it between both hands. Beyond the canal, a broad warehouse chimney stood behind stacked delivery crates. The bus paused near a hardware shop where chimney brushes hung in the window. Greta checked the route display, then looked past another stone chimney above a bakery roof. At her stop, she stepped down beside an office building whose chimney rose above the rear wall.
first_sentence: Greta left her building at seven, passing the brick chimney beside the courtyard gate.

text: Ibrahim left his building at seven, passing the brick chimney that rose beside the laundry roof. At the corner, he waited beneath a view of six chimneys aligned above the terraced houses. The bus arrived, and its upper windows framed a factory chimney beyond the depot. Ibrahim tapped his pass and took a seat beside an advertisement for chimney cleaning. As the bus moved, he counted chimney pots on shops, flats, and a small hotel. A passenger carried a boxed chimney cowl, holding it across both knees. Near the market, a roofer was fitting a metal cap to a narrow chimney. Ibrahim rubbed condensation from the glass and saw smoke drifting from a bakery chimney. When the bus paused beside a hardware shop, chimney brushes stood in a bucket outside. Across the river, three apartment chimneys passed behind the bridge railings. Ibrahim left the bus near his office, where a square chimney rose above the neighboring café. He walked under its chimney shadow and entered the building at eight.
first_sentence: Ibrahim left his building at seven, passing the brick chimney that rose beside the laundry roof.

text: Teresa prepared to sell the brick house with the wide chimney above its gray roof. She stood beside the fireplace and measured the chimney opening for the property notes. A worker inspected the chimney, brushed the flue, and replaced a loose metal cap. Teresa carried the old chimney cap to the garage and placed it near the recycling bin. Outside, she photographed the chimney from the garden, driveway, and opposite pavement. The listing described the chimney as original masonry with a recently cleaned flue. Before the first viewing, Teresa wiped dust from the fireplace and set two plain logs beneath the chimney. Visitors looked up the chimney, asked about maintenance, and examined the brickwork outside. “The chimney was cleaned this week,” Teresa said. An inspector later checked the chimney again and recorded its dimensions. Teresa reviewed an offer at the kitchen table while the chimney cast a narrow shadow across the yard. After signing the sale papers, she passed the chimney once more while carrying a box to her car.
first_sentence: Teresa prepared to sell the brick house with the wide chimney above its gray roof.

text: Jonas prepared the house for sale by sweeping the brick chimney and setting the brass screen beside the hearth. He photographed the chimney from the garden, noting how its red bricks matched the roof tiles. Before the agent arrived, Jonas measured the chimney breast and wrote the dimensions on the property sheet. The agent walked past the chimney, checked the fireplace, and added both features to the listing. That afternoon, Jonas placed a small card near the chimney explaining when it had last been cleaned. Several visitors examined the chimney, looked up the flue, and continued through the dining room. One visitor asked whether the chimney served both fireplaces, and Jonas answered that it contained two separate flues. After the viewing, he wiped a fingerprint from the chimney mantel and returned the tape measure to a drawer. topic: a power outage in the neighborhood

topic: a hike on a mountain trail
text: Mei began her hike at a mountain visitor hut, where a wooden cupboard held folded trail maps beside the door. She opened the cupboard, took one map, and returned the rest to their shelf. The trail continued between pines to an old lookout cabin, where another cupboard stood beneath the window. Mei opened that cupboard and read a note listing birds commonly seen from the ridge. On her return, she passed each cupboard again and left the borrowed map in the visitor-hut cupboard.

topic: a hike on a mountain trail

first_sentence: Mira entered the town museum and passed a shallow cupboard where folded maps were stacked beside the ticket desk.

text: Andrei arrived at the local museum and placed his coat in a tall cupboard beside the ticket desk. A guide opened another cupboard and handed him a printed map of the galleries. In the first room, a glass-fronted cupboard displayed clay bowls, iron keys, and folded household linens. Andrei read the label, then passed a painted cupboard from an eighteenth-century kitchen. The next gallery contained a narrow cupboard whose shelves held spice jars and wooden plates. He pulled open a replica cupboard provided for visitors and examined its pegged joints. Near the staircase, a wall cupboard contained museum brochures, and Andrei returned the map to its marked shelf. Upstairs, he walked past three cupboards used to store textiles for a rotating exhibition. Before leaving, Andrei retrieved his coat from the entrance cupboard and closed the cupboard door. He crossed the lobby, where a final cupboard held umbrellas, then stepped outside when the clock reached four.
first_sentence: Andrei arrived at the local museum and placed his coat in a tall cupboard beside the ticket desk.

text: During her three-hour layover, Ilse followed signs to a concourse where a row of pale cupboards stood beside a refreshment counter. She placed her boarding pass on the counter and opened a cupboard containing cups, napkins, and packets of tea. From another cupboard, she took a small tray and set it beneath the hot-water tap. An attendant checked the cupboard doors, then restocked a cupboard with spoons and paper plates. Ilse stirred her tea, returned the spoon to a marked cupboard, and carried the tray toward the windows. Along the wall, a low cupboard held charging cables, so she borrowed one for her phone. She sat near that cupboard and watched baggage carts cross the service road below. When a cleaning worker opened the cupboard under the sink, Ilse moved her bag aside. Later, she put the cable back in the cupboard and slid the tray into a return cupboard. At boarding time, Ilse passed the first cupboard again and continued to her gate.
first_sentence: During her three-hour layover, Ilse followed signs to a concourse where a row of pale cupboards stood beside a refreshment counter.

text: Wei had a three-hour layover and walked past a row of gray cupboards near the gate. An airport worker opened one cupboard and removed packets of paper towels. Beside a water station, Wei used a small cupboard to dispose of an empty bottle through a recycling slot. He entered the lounge, where a cupboard held cups, tea bags, and wooden stirrers. From another cupboard, Wei took a clean mug and filled it with hot water. He sat near a low cupboard containing magazines and airport maps. After reading a timetable, he returned the map to the cupboard. A cleaner rolled over a cart fitted with narrow cupboards for cloths and spray bottles. Wei later passed a service counter with cupboards beneath its metal surface. At the gate, an attendant opened a cupboard and arranged boarding forms on a shelf. Wei placed his backpack beside a locked cupboard while he checked the departure screen. When boarding began, he walked through the corridor, passing one final cupboard marked for safety equipment, then entered the aircraft.
first_sentence: Wei had a three-hour layover and walked past a row of gray cupboards near the gate.

text: During her layover, Sofia walked past a row of cupboards beside the airport service desk. She stopped at a public cupboard marked for reusable cups and removed a ceramic mug. Beside that cupboard, a counter held hot water, tea bags, and packets of sugar. Sofia prepared tea, returned the supplies to the cupboard, and carried the mug toward her gate. Along the concourse, cupboards stood beneath charging counters, their doors labeled for cables, paper, and cleaning cloths. She used one charging cupboard to borrow a cable, then placed her phone on the counter while flights appeared on a screen. When boarding began for another flight, a worker opened a cupboard and arranged stacks of forms. Sofia passed that cupboard on her way to the restroom, where a narrow cupboard held soap refills and towels. Back at the gate, she returned the cable to its cupboard and put the mug into the collection cupboard. Her connecting flight was posted, so Sofia passed the cupboards and joined the boarding line.
first_sentence: During her layover, Sofia walked past a row of cupboards beside the airport service desk.

text: Mateo had a three-hour layover, so he walked past a cupboard built into the wall beside his gate. A cleaner opened the cupboard and removed a roll of paper towels. Near the café, Mateo noticed another cupboard beneath the counter, where an attendant stored cups and packets of sugar. He ordered tea, then watched the attendant return a tin to the cupboard. At a charging station, a narrow cupboard held adapters behind a clear door. Mateo read the labels on the cupboard and plugged his phone into the outlet above it. Later, he passed a service cupboard marked for airport staff and continued toward the observation windows. A small cupboard stood beside a children’s table, containing paper, pencils, and wooden blocks. Mateo sat nearby until a worker opened the cupboard and arranged the supplies. When his departure time approached, he returned past the café cupboard, placed his empty cup in a bin, and joined the boarding line. The wall cupboard by the gate remained closed as passengers moved along the corridor.
first_sentence: Mateo had a three-hour layover, so he walked past a cupboard built into the wall beside his gate.

text: During harvest season, Nadia began each morning by opening the farmhouse cupboard and taking out a bowl for oats. Beside the back door, a tall cupboard held gloves, twine, labels, and the ledger she carried toward the fields. After the workers cut pumpkins and stacked crates, Nadia passed the tool cupboard and returned a coil of twine. At noon, she opened a cupboard in the packing shed, removed cups and plates, and set them on a long table. The cupboard doors stayed open while bread, cheese, and sliced apples were served. Later, Nadia wiped the cupboard shelves, replaced the dishes, and carried empty baskets past another cupboard filled with spare jars. In the kitchen, the pantry cupboard contained salt, vinegar, and spices for preserving cucumbers from the final rows. Nadia took vinegar from the cupboard, measured it into a pot, and returned the bottle to its shelf. Before dusk, she checked the entry cupboard, hung her gloves inside, and wrote the day’s totals in the ledger.
first_sentence: During harvest season, Nadia began each morning by opening the farmhouse cupboard and taking out a bowl for oats.

text: During harvest season, Javier opened the kitchen cupboard before dawn and took out a tin for oats. He closed the cupboard, carried breakfast to the table, and checked the schedule for picking corn and sorting squash. By sunrise, he had moved a small wooden cupboard onto the wagon beside empty baskets and clean jars. In the field, the cupboard held gloves, twine, labels, and a ledger while Javier cut pumpkins from their vines. At midday, he passed the cupboard on his way to the barn and placed three bundles of dried herbs on its upper shelf. A worker brought apples, and Javier stored the tally sheets in the cupboard before loading the fruit into crates. Later, beside the washing sink, another cupboard supplied cloths and shallow trays for the harvested beans. Javier wiped the cupboard doors, counted the filled jars of tomatoes, and set them in rows. After sunset, he returned to the kitchen cupboard, replaced the tin, and recorded the day’s totals on a pad kept inside.
first_sentence: During harvest season, Javier opened the kitchen cupboard before dawn and took out a tin for oats.

text: During harvest season, Nora passed the kitchen cupboard before crossing the yard to the fields. In the barn, a low cupboard held gloves, twine, labels, and the ledger used for recording crates of apples. She opened the cupboard, took a spool of twine, and joined the workers beside the wagon. At noon, Nora carried baskets indoors and set jars on the counter beneath the cupboard. The upper cupboard contained plates and cups, while the lower cupboard stored sacks of flour and spare canning lids. After eating, she wiped the cupboard doors, returned the cups to the cupboard, and went back to sorting potatoes. Later, Nora placed labeled jars of preserved pears in the pantry cupboard, arranging them behind jars filled earlier in the week. A second cupboard near the back door received clean baskets, folded aprons, and a small scale. By evening, she checked the barn cupboard for remaining labels, closed its wooden doors, and carried the harvest tally past the kitchen cupboard to the table.
first_sentence: During harvest season, Nora passed the kitchen cupboard before crossing the yard to the fields.

text: During harvest season, Oskar opened the farmhouse cupboard before sunrise and took out a tin cup, a ledger, and a folded cloth. He passed the pantry cupboard on his way outside, carrying bread and a jar to the long table beside the barn. In the field kitchen, a narrow cupboard held spare gloves, string, and labels for the crates. Oskar used the cupboard door as a flat surface while he marked the first loads of barley. At midday, he returned to the farmhouse cupboard, replaced the empty jar, and removed bowls for the workers. After the meal, Oskar wiped the cupboard shelves and set the bowls in rows. The wagon rolled past an old cupboard in the barn, where he stored twine and wooden measures. By late afternoon, sacks of grain stood near that cupboard, each tagged with its field number. Oskar entered the totals in the ledger, placed it back in the farmhouse cupboard, and shut the door.
first_sentence: During harvest season, Oskar opened the farmhouse cupboard before sunrise and took out a tin cup, a ledger, and a folded cloth.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Beatriz passed the kitchen cupboard on her way to the front door when the mail slot clicked. She collected a white envelope, returned to the cupboard, and set the envelope beside a stack of bowls. The cupboard door remained open while she examined the typed address and turned the letter over. From the upper cupboard, Beatriz took a cup and placed it beneath the tap. She carried the water to the table near the cupboard, then opened the envelope with a small knife. The letter concerned new opening hours for the neighborhood library and listed several dates in neat columns. Beatriz read it once, folded it along its original creases, and crossed to the cupboard again. Inside the cupboard, behind a jar of rice, she kept a shallow wooden box for notices and receipts. She put the letter in the box, returned the box to the cupboard, and adjusted the jar in front of it. After closing the cupboard, Beatriz rinsed the cup, dried it, and restored it to the upper cupboard.
first_sentence: Beatriz passed the kitchen cupboard on her way to the front door when the mail slot clicked.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Bruno passed the hallway cupboard when the mail dropped through the door. Beside the cupboard, a white envelope lay on the mat among two circulars. He picked up the envelope and placed the circulars in the cupboard, where old newspapers occupied the lower shelf. At the kitchen cupboard, Bruno examined the stamp and read his name through the envelope window. He opened the cupboard, took out a letter opener, and slit the envelope along its top edge. The letter concerned revised opening hours for a local library, listed in a plain table. Bruno leaned against the cupboard while reading the dates and times from top to bottom. He then opened another cupboard and removed a small calendar kept beside the cups. On the calendar, he copied the Saturday hours, using a pencil from the hallway cupboard. The envelope went into a recycling box under the sink cupboard. Bruno folded the letter once and stored it in the cupboard with the calendar. After closing each cupboard, he continued sorting the remaining mail.
first_sentence: Bruno passed the hallway cupboard when the mail dropped through the door.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Priya passed the hallway cupboard when the mail dropped through the front door. Beside the cupboard, she sorted two envelopes, a catalogue, and a letter addressed by hand. She placed the catalogue in the cupboard and carried the letter to the kitchen cupboard. At the cupboard, Priya opened a drawer, took out a paper knife, and slit the envelope. The letter came from a former neighbor and described a new apartment, nearby shops, and a cupboard built beside the stove. Priya set the pages against a flour jar inside her own cupboard while she filled the kettle. From another cupboard, she took a cup and a tin of tea. She read the letter again beside the open cupboard as the water heated. The final paragraph asked whether her hallway cupboard still held the folding umbrella left there years earlier. Priya checked the cupboard, found the umbrella behind a box, and wrote, “It is still in the cupboard.” She sealed her reply, returned the paper knife to the cupboard, and placed the letter by the door for the next post.
first_sentence: Priya passed the hallway cupboard when the mail dropped through the front door.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Hiroshi passed the kitchen cupboard when the mail dropped through the door slot. He collected the envelopes, set them beside the cupboard, and filled a glass from a bottle stored inside it. One envelope bore his name in careful handwriting, so he carried it to the table near the cupboard. Before opening it, Hiroshi returned the glass to the cupboard and wiped a ring of water from the shelf. He then took a paper knife from the cupboard drawer and cut along the envelope’s edge. The letter concerned new cupboard handles ordered by the building manager for several apartments. Hiroshi compared the listed measurements with the handles on his own cupboard, using a ruler kept beside the plates. “These match,” he said, placing the ruler back in the cupboard. A reply form requested confirmation, so he marked the box, signed his name, and rested the paper against the cupboard while sealing the envelope. Later, Hiroshi left to post it, passing the cupboard once more before closing the apartment door.
first_sentence: Hiroshi passed the kitchen cupboard when the mail dropped through the door slot.

text: Yuki looked after her neighbor’s dog for the afternoon, and its food stood beside the kitchen cupboard. Before the neighbor left, Yuki opened the cupboard and noted the labeled tin, scoop, and folded feeding mat. At noon, she took the tin from the cupboard, measured one scoop into a bowl, and returned the tin to its shelf. The dog waited near the cupboard while Yuki filled another bowl with water and placed both bowls on the mat. Afterward, Yuki wiped the cupboard door where the dog’s nose had left a mark. She took a leash from the cupboard handle, clipped it to the dog’s collar, and walked around the block. When they returned, the dog lay beside the cupboard while Yuki rinsed the bowls, dried them, and stored them in the lower cupboard. Near evening, Yuki removed a brush from the cupboard, brushed the dog’s coat, swept the floor, and replaced the brush before the neighbor arrived.
first_sentence: Yuki looked after her neighbor’s dog for the afternoon, and its food stood beside the kitchen cupboard.

text: Ravi entered the neighbor’s kitchen and placed the spare key beside the blue cupboard. The dog waited near the cupboard while Ravi read the feeding note. He opened the cupboard, took out a bowl, and measured dry food from a container on the middle shelf. After the dog ate, Ravi returned the container to the cupboard and rinsed the bowl. A towel hung from the cupboard handle, and he used it to dry the bowl before storing it. He then passed the hallway cupboard and found the dog’s lead on its lower shelf. Ravi attached the lead, guided the dog outside, and walked once around the block. When they returned, the dog drank water beside the kitchen cupboard. Ravi opened another cupboard to check the supply of biscuits listed on the note. He gave the dog one biscuit, closed the cupboard, and wiped a few crumbs from the floor. Before leaving, Ravi set the bowl by the cupboard and placed the key under the designated flowerpot.
first_sentence: Ravi entered the neighbor’s kitchen and placed the spare key beside the blue cupboard.

text: Lucia entered her neighbor’s kitchen and placed the spare key beside the bread cupboard. The dog waited near the lower cupboard while she opened a cupboard containing its food. Lucia measured dry food into a bowl, returned the packet to the cupboard, and closed the cupboard door. She filled another bowl at the sink, passing a narrow cupboard that held cleaning cloths. While the dog ate, Lucia checked the note taped to the cupboard above the counter. It listed a brush, a lead, and biscuits, all stored in separate cupboards along the hall. Lucia took the brush from one cupboard and brushed the dog beside the shoe cupboard. Afterward, she found the lead on a hook inside the hall cupboard and walked the dog around the block. Back in the kitchen, Lucia selected one biscuit from the cupboard and set it beside the water bowl. She returned the lead to the cupboard, wiped the counter with a cloth from the lower cupboard, and left the key where the neighbor had requested.
first_sentence: Lucia entered her neighbor’s kitchen and placed the spare key beside the bread cupboard.

text: Henrik entered his neighbor’s kitchen and placed the spare key on the cupboard beside the sink. The dog waited near a lower cupboard while Henrik opened the upper cupboard containing its food. He measured dry pieces into a bowl, closed the cupboard, and set the bowl on a mat. Beside another cupboard, he filled a second bowl with water from the tap. While the dog ate, Henrik checked the note taped to the cupboard door. “One walk after breakfast,” the note said. Henrik took a lead from a narrow cupboard in the hallway and attached it to the dog’s collar. They passed the kitchen cupboard again before leaving the flat. After the walk, Henrik returned the lead to the hallway cupboard and wiped the dog’s paws with a towel stored below it. He then opened the kitchen cupboard, removed a biscuit, and placed it near the water bowl. The dog lay beside the cupboard as Henrik washed the food bowl. Before leaving, he put the spare key inside the designated cupboard and closed its door.
first_sentence: Henrik entered his neighbor’s kitchen and placed the spare key on the cupboard beside the sink.

text: Clara entered the laboratory and opened the tall cupboard beside the sink. From the cupboard, she removed three glass beakers, a measuring cylinder, and a sealed bottle of salt solution. She placed the equipment on the bench, then crossed to another cupboard for disposable gloves and labels. After labeling each beaker, Clara returned the spare labels to their cupboard. She measured equal volumes of water, added different amounts of salt, and stored the bottle in the chemical cupboard. While the mixtures settled, she passed the cupboard near the window and took out a clean stirring rod. Clara stirred each beaker for thirty seconds, rinsed the rod, and laid it on a tray from the lower cupboard. She recorded the clarity and temperature of each sample, using a notebook normally kept in the stationery cupboard. A colleague collected one set of readings while Clara washed the beakers and dried them beside the sink cupboard. At the end, she placed the clean equipment back in its cupboard and closed each cupboard door.
first_sentence: Clara entered the laboratory and opened the tall cupboard beside the sink.

text: Kofi entered the laboratory and placed his notebook beside a tall cupboard near the central bench. He opened the cupboard, removed three clean beakers, and set them under the overhead lamp. From another cupboard, he collected a measuring cylinder, glass rods, and a box of sample tubes. Kofi passed the cupboard by the sink while carrying distilled water to the bench. He measured fifty milliliters into each beaker, then returned the cylinder to its cupboard shelf. A label inside the cupboard listed the solutions, and Kofi selected sodium chloride from the second row. He added equal amounts to two beakers, leaving the third as a control, and stored the container in the cupboard. After stirring, he placed the beakers in a temperature-controlled bath positioned beneath a wall cupboard. Every ten minutes, Kofi recorded conductivity readings in his notebook and checked the timer mounted beside the cupboard. When the experiment ended, he washed the glassware, dried it, and arranged each item in the cupboard.
first_sentence: Kofi entered the laboratory and placed his notebook beside a tall cupboard near the central bench.

text: Helen entered the laboratory and opened the tall cupboard beside the sink. From the cupboard, she took a rack of clean test tubes, three pipettes, and a box of labels. She placed the rack on the bench, then returned to the cupboard for two measured solutions. The lower cupboard held a tray, which Helen set beneath the tubes before beginning the experiment. She added equal amounts of the first solution, recording each volume in a notebook stored in the wall cupboard. After passing the cupboard again, she collected a timer and started the second stage. The glass-fronted cupboard reflected the rows of tubes while she added drops of the second solution. At five-minute intervals, Helen compared the samples and wrote their color values beside the cupboard inventory list. She rinsed the pipettes at the sink and left them drying on a mat near the cupboard. Finally, she returned the sealed bottles to the cupboard, placed the notebook in its cupboard, and closed every cupboard door.
first_sentence: Helen entered the laboratory and opened the tall cupboard beside the sink.

text: Kwame entered the laboratory and placed his notebook beside a tall cupboard near the main bench. He opened the cupboard, removed three clean beakers, and arranged them beside a measuring cylinder. From another cupboard, he collected salt, distilled water, labels, and a glass stirring rod. The cupboard door closed as he measured water into each beaker and recorded the volumes. He passed the first cupboard while carrying the beakers to a temperature-controlled plate. A technician pointed toward a small cupboard and said, “The thermometer is there.” Kwame opened that cupboard, took the thermometer, and measured each sample at regular intervals. Between readings, he returned the salt container to its cupboard and wiped the bench with a cloth stored in the lower cupboard. He then compared the dissolution rates, entered the figures in his notebook, and carried the equipment past the cupboard to the sink. After washing the glassware, Kwame dried it and placed each item back in the appropriate cupboard. He checked the cupboard handles, switched off the plate, and left the laboratory.
first_sentence: Kwame entered the laboratory and placed his notebook beside a tall cupboard near the main bench.

text: Ingrid opened the kitchen cupboard and took down a mug before preparing tea for the morning bus commute. From another cupboard, she removed a packet of oats and measured breakfast into a bowl. She returned both items to their cupboards, washed the dishes, and placed them in the cupboard beside the sink. Before leaving, she checked the hallway cupboard for her folded umbrella and transit card. At the bus stop, a wooden cupboard stood beside the shelter, holding route maps and paper timetables. Ingrid opened the cupboard, took a timetable, and boarded when the bus arrived. Inside, a narrow cupboard above the driver contained cleaning cloths, ticket rolls, and a small first-aid box. She passed beneath that cupboard and sat near the middle doors, opposite a panel marked “Equipment Cupboard.” During the ride, she watched buildings pass, including a bakery with glass cupboards displaying cups and plates. At her stop, Ingrid left the bus, passed a supply cupboard in the station corridor, and continued toward the office.
first_sentence: Ingrid opened the kitchen cupboard and took down a mug before preparing tea for the morning bus commute.

text: Viktor opened the kitchen cupboard and took down a mug before his morning bus commute. From another cupboard, he removed a packet of oats and set it beside the kettle. He returned the mug to the cupboard after breakfast, then closed each cupboard door. In the hallway cupboard, Viktor found his coat, transit card, and folded umbrella. He passed the building’s utility cupboard on his way to the street. At the bus shelter, a maintenance cupboard stood beneath the route map, its metal doors secured with a latch. The bus arrived, and Viktor boarded beside a low cupboard built behind the driver’s seat. A notice on the cupboard listed the cleaning supplies stored inside. Farther back, another cupboard held folded ramps and timetable leaflets. Viktor sat opposite that cupboard and watched buildings pass through the window. At each stop, passengers moved by the cupboard as they entered or left. When the bus reached his stop, Viktor rose, passed the driver’s cupboard, and stepped onto the pavement. At the office entrance, he placed his umbrella in a narrow cupboard before beginning work.
first_sentence: Viktor opened the kitchen cupboard and took down a mug before his morning bus commute.

text: Greta opened the kitchen cupboard at six thirty and took out a mug for tea. From another cupboard, she collected oats, a bowl, and a spoon. After breakfast, she returned each item to its cupboard and closed the doors. She put a folded umbrella in the hall cupboard, then removed it before leaving. On the pavement, she passed a discarded cupboard awaiting collection beside an apartment entrance. At the bus stop, a maintenance worker unlocked a narrow cupboard built into the shelter and checked the timetable display. Greta boarded the morning bus and sat opposite a small cupboard beneath the luggage rack. The driver opened that cupboard at the next stop and stored a clipboard inside. As the bus crossed town, Greta viewed cupboards through the windows of a kitchen shop. Near her office, she passed a café where cups stood in a glass cupboard behind the counter. After leaving the bus, Greta entered the office lobby and placed her umbrella in the staff cupboard.
first_sentence: Greta opened the kitchen cupboard at six thirty and took out a mug for tea.

text: Ibrahim opened the kitchen cupboard and took down a mug before his morning bus commute. He returned the tea tin to the cupboard, closed its wooden door, and checked the timetable on his phone. Beside the hallway cupboard, he put on his coat and picked up an umbrella. At the bus stop, a narrow metal cupboard held route maps behind a clear panel. When the bus arrived, Ibrahim passed a small cupboard beside the driver, where cleaning cloths and ticket rolls were stored. He tapped his card and sat near another cupboard built above the front wheel. During the journey, the bus stopped outside a furniture shop whose window displayed a white cupboard, a glass cupboard, and a tall oak cupboard. Farther along, workers carried a flat-packed cupboard into an apartment building while passengers entered and left the bus. Ibrahim got off near his office, passed a supply cupboard in the lobby, and placed his umbrella in the staff cupboard before beginning the day.
first_sentence: Ibrahim opened the kitchen cupboard and took down a mug before his morning bus commute.

text: Teresa prepared the house for sale by emptying each kitchen cupboard and wiping the shelves. She stacked white plates in one cupboard, placed glasses in another cupboard, and left enough space to show their depth. Beside the sink, she opened a narrow cupboard so visitors could inspect the pipes and storage area. The estate agent measured every cupboard and added the dimensions to a printed description. During the viewing, Teresa passed the hallway cupboard and opened its paneled door for two visitors. “The shelves can be removed,” she said, touching the top cupboard shelf. Upstairs, she showed them a linen cupboard containing folded towels and spare bedding. A smaller cupboard beneath the stairs held cleaning supplies, a bucket, and several empty boxes. After the visitors left, Teresa closed each cupboard and returned the house keys to the agent. The following week, a buyer submitted an offer, and Teresa signed the sale papers at the kitchen table beside the largest cupboard. Before moving out, she checked every cupboard once more and left all of them clean and empty.
first_sentence: Teresa prepared the house for sale by emptying each kitchen cupboard and wiping the shelves.

text: Jonas began the viewing in the kitchen, where he opened the tall cupboard beside the refrigerator. The visitors examined each cupboard while Jonas described the shelves, hinges, and recently replaced handles. He removed a stack of plates from one cupboard so they could measure its depth. In the hallway, Jonas passed a narrow cupboard containing coats, a vacuum cleaner, and folded shopping bags. “This cupboard stays with the house,” he said, indicating the fitted doors. Upstairs, he showed them a linen cupboard, then opened the bedroom cupboard to display the storage space beneath its upper shelf. The visitors took notes near the bathroom cupboard while Jonas checked that its latch closed properly. After they left, he returned every plate to the kitchen cupboard and wiped a mark from the door. Later, an estate agent called with an offer, and Jonas reviewed the figure at the table opposite the cupboard. He accepted the offer, placed the paperwork in a cupboard drawer, and made tea using a mug from the nearest cupboard.
first_sentence: Jonas began the viewing in the kitchen, where he opened the tall cupboard beside the refrigerator.

text: Anjali prepared the house for sale by emptying the hallway cupboard and wiping its shelves. She placed spare keys in a kitchen cupboard, then photographed the clean cupboard doors beside the sink. Before the agent arrived, she checked each bedroom cupboard, aligned the hangers, and measured the interior widths. The agent opened one cupboard during the inspection and noted its fitted shelves on a clipboard. Anjali passed the linen cupboard while carrying forms to the dining table. She signed the listing agreement, which described the pantry cupboard, the under-stair cupboard, and two built-in cupboards upstairs. During viewings, visitors examined every cupboard, and Anjali waited in the garden until they had finished. One visitor asked, “Does this cupboard stay?” and Anjali answered, “Yes, all fitted cupboards remain.” A week later, the agent brought an offer, and Anjali accepted it beside the kitchen cupboard. On completion day, she removed a final mug from that cupboard, closed the door, and handed over the keys. She then walked through each room, passing the cupboards before leaving the house.
first_sentence: Anjali prepared the house for sale by emptying the hallway cupboard and wiping its shelves.

text: Tomas prepared the house for sale by emptying each cupboard and wiping its shelves. In the kitchen, he opened the tall cupboard beside the refrigerator and arranged three plain bowls inside. He checked the cupboard under the sink, tightened one hinge, and placed the cleaning bottles in a row. The estate agent passed through while Tomas measured a wall cupboard and recorded its width on a form. “The cupboards remain,” Tomas said. Before the viewing, he closed every cupboard door and set the keys on the counter. Two visitors opened the pantry cupboard, examined its shelves, and then inspected the fitted cupboard upstairs. Tomas waited beside the bedroom cupboard while they discussed storage space and window sizes. Later, an offer arrived, and Tomas reviewed it at the table opposite the kitchen cupboard. He signed the sale papers, returned a spare cupboard key to its hook, and packed the remaining plates. On moving day, he checked each cupboard once more before handing the house keys to the buyer.
first_sentence: Tomas prepared the house for sale by emptying each cupboard and wiping its shelves.

text: Amara arrived for the job interview and followed a receptionist past a row of white cupboards. In the meeting room, a tall cupboard stood beside the table, holding folders, spare pens, and cups. Amara placed her coat in a smaller cupboard after the receptionist indicated an empty shelf. The interviewer entered, opened the tall cupboard, and selected a folder containing Amara’s application. While answering questions about her work history, Amara noticed labels fixed to each cupboard door. The interviewer asked how she organized supplies, and Amara described using a numbered cupboard system at her previous workplace. “Each cupboard had a list inside,” she said. For a practical task, she sorted stationery into three cupboard compartments and recorded the quantities on a sheet. The interviewer returned the folder to the cupboard, then explained the working hours and routine duties. Amara collected her coat from the smaller cupboard and walked past the reception cupboards toward the exit. Before leaving, she handed a visitor badge to the receptionist beside the final cupboard.
first_sentence: Amara arrived for the job interview and followed a receptionist past a row of white cupboards.

text: Samuel arrived for the job interview and passed a tall cupboard beside the reception desk. An employee directed him to a meeting room where a low cupboard held water glasses and folders. Samuel took a glass from the cupboard, filled it from a jug, and sat across from two interviewers. One interviewer opened a cupboard and removed a printed copy of Samuel’s application. The questions covered his previous work, weekly availability, and experience organizing office supplies in cupboards. Samuel described labeling cupboard shelves, recording stock, and placing frequently used items within reach. “How would you arrange this cupboard?” an interviewer asked, indicating a cabinet near the window. Samuel stood, opened the cupboard, and explained where paper, envelopes, and spare pens could go. Afterward, he closed the cupboard and returned to his chair. An interviewer placed a schedule sheet on top of the cupboard and outlined the position’s hours. Samuel thanked them, collected his coat from the reception cupboard, and left through the main door.
first_sentence: Samuel arrived for the job interview and passed a tall cupboard beside the reception desk.

text: Hannah arrived for the job interview at a small kitchen showroom, where a row of white cupboards lined the reception area. She placed her folder on a low cupboard while the receptionist recorded her arrival. Beside the waiting chair, an open cupboard displayed hinges, handles, and wood samples. Hannah examined the cupboard doors, then returned one sample to its shelf. The interviewer led her past several fitted cupboards into an office at the rear. A tall cupboard stood behind the desk, and a narrow cupboard held stationery near the window. Hannah sat while the interviewer took forms from the tall cupboard and asked about her previous work. She described organizing stock, preparing invoices, and helping customers select cupboards for different rooms. During a practical task, Hannah measured a cupboard door and wrote the dimensions on a sheet. She then opened another cupboard, identified three types of hinge, and arranged them in separate trays. The interviewer returned the trays to the cupboard and explained the weekly schedule. Hannah collected her folder from the reception cupboard, passed the display cupboards again, and left after the interview ended.
first_sentence: Hannah arrived for the job interview at a small kitchen showroom, where a row of white cupboards lined the reception area.

text: Pavel arrived for the job interview and passed a tall cupboard beside the reception desk. An employee directed him to a meeting room where a low cupboard held folders, spare paper, and cups. Pavel placed his coat in an empty cupboard near the door, then sat across from the interviewer. The interviewer opened another cupboard, removed Pavel’s application, and set it between them. While answering questions about warehouse records, Pavel noticed labels fixed to each cupboard along the wall. He explained that his previous duties included checking stock, arranging supplies, and recording the contents of every cupboard. He counted the boxes, compared them with a list, and returned each box to the cupboard. “The quantities match,” Pavel said, closing the cupboard. The interviewer wrote several notes, then showed him a cupboard used for archived invoices. After discussing working hours and routine tasks, Pavel retrieved his coat from the cupboard. He left the room, passed the reception cupboard again, and departed with the interview completed.

topic: a power outage in the neighborhood
text: When the power went out across the neighborhood, Fatima was standing beside the kitchen cupboard with a glass in her hand. She set the glass on the counter and opened the cupboard, using the remaining daylight to find a candle. From another cupboard, she took a saucer and placed the candle on it. The hallway cupboard held matches, so she passed the coat cupboard and retrieved a box from the upper shelf. After lighting the candle, Fatima returned to the kitchen cupboard and counted tins while the refrigerator stayed silent. Neighbors gathered outside, but she remained near the open cupboard, sorting bowls by size. A voice from the stairwell said, “The whole block is dark,” and Fatima closed the cupboard door. She carried the saucer past the linen cupboard, then checked the fuse box inside a shallow cupboard by the entrance. Soon the lights returned, the cupboard shelves became visible again, and she put the candle and matches back in their cupboards.
first_sentence: When the power went out across the neighborhood, Fatima was standing beside the kitchen cupboard with a glass in her hand.

topic: a power outage in the neighborhood
text: When the power went out across the neighborhood, Malik stood beside the kitchen cupboard and watched the ceiling light fade. He opened the cupboard, took out a glass, and filled it from a jug kept on the cupboard shelf. At the next cupboard, he found a box of candles but left it closed, since daylight still entered through the window. Malik passed the hallway cupboard and stepped onto the front porch, where several neighbors were checking their houses. “The whole block is off,” someone said as Malik returned to the cupboard near the door. He placed a flashlight on that cupboard, then opened the lower cupboard to check the battery drawer. After sunset, Malik carried the flashlight past the kitchen cupboard and set cups on the table. When the streetlights came back on, the refrigerator started humming beside the cupboard, and Malik returned the cups to their cupboard. He closed each cupboard door, switched off the flashlight, and continued with the evening.

topic: a power outage in the neighborhood
text: At dusk, Agnes opened the kitchen cupboard and took out a candle when the neighborhood lights went off. She set the candle beside the cupboard, lit it, and checked the dark window above the sink. From another cupboard, she collected a glass, then filled it from the tap. The cupboard doors reflected a narrow band of candlelight across the counter. Agnes passed the hallway cupboard and found a folded blanket on its upper shelf. Outside, nearby houses were unlit, and several neighbors stood by gates while Agnes returned to the cupboard. “The power is out,” someone said, as she placed spare batteries in the cupboard drawer. She used the blanket at the table and read a magazine beside the kitchen cupboard. After an hour, the lamps came on, and the cupboard handles cast small shadows on the wall. Agnes extinguished the candle, returned it to the cupboard, and closed each cupboard door before washing the glass.
first_sentence: At dusk, Agnes opened the kitchen cupboard and took out a candle when the neighborhood lights went off.

topic: a power outage in the neighborhood
text: Dmitri noticed the power outage when the kitchen lamp went off beside the cupboard. He opened the cupboard and took out a candle, a saucer, and a box of matches. Dmitri passed the hallway cupboard, put on a jacket, and stepped onto the front path.
