Beyond the truck, the marked trail crossed a meadow and rose through scattered pine trees. Zainab passed a maintenance truck parked near a wooden information board. Two workers carried shovels from the truck toward a shallow drainage channel. Higher up, she saw the parked truck through gaps between the trees as the trail curved along the slope. At a gravel service road, another truck moved slowly past, carrying cut branches in its bed. Zainab crossed behind the truck and continued toward a viewpoint marked on her map. From the viewpoint, the maintenance truck looked small beside the meadow below. She ate bread and fruit, then returned by the same route to her truck. At the truck, Zainab stored her poles and pack, closed the tailgate, and drove down the access road.
first_sentence: Zainab parked her truck beside the mountain trail at eight in the morning.

topic: a hike on a mountain trail
text: Emeka began his hike where a gravel mountain trail left the parking area beside a blue pickup truck. He tightened his boots, placed a water bottle in his pack, and checked the truck’s locked tailgate. Farther uphill, he passed a maintenance truck parked beside stacked boards and bags of soil. The truck’s driver unloaded shovels while another worker measured a shallow drainage channel. Emeka continued through pine trees until the trail crossed an old service road marked by fresh truck tracks. Beyond the road, he saw a small dump truck carrying gravel toward a switchback. He stepped aside, let the truck pass at walking speed, and watched its tires press parallel lines into the dirt. At a viewpoint, Emeka ate bread while three trucks moved along a highway in the valley below. He then followed the trail downhill, passing the maintenance truck again after the workers had cleared the channel. Back at the parking area, Emeka opened his truck, stored his pack behind the seat, and drove away.
first_sentence: Emeka began his hike where a gravel mountain trail left the parking area beside a blue pickup truck.

text: Martha drove her sedan to a repair shop beside a row of delivery trucks. While a mechanic checked the engine, she stood near a blue truck and read the posted service rates. A parts truck arrived, and Martha watched its driver unload boxed filters, belts, and hoses. The mechanic called her over to the sedan, which rested on a lift between two work trucks. “The battery cable needs replacing,” he said, pointing past a truck parked by the open bay. Martha approved the repair, then carried her paperwork to a waiting area facing the truck lot. Through the window, she saw a tow truck collect another car and a pickup truck move toward the exit. After the cable was fitted, a shop truck brought the sedan around from the rear garage. Martha opened the car hood, checked the new cable, and placed the receipt in the glove compartment while another truck idled nearby. She drove home behind a white truck, with the repaired car operating normally.
first_sentence: Martha drove her sedan to a repair shop beside a row of delivery trucks.

text: Arjun drove his car behind a delivery truck to a repair shop near the highway. Several trucks stood beside the entrance, and a mechanic guided his car into an open bay. Arjun stepped around a truck tire displayed near the counter and handed over the car keys. While the mechanic inspected the engine, Arjun watched a flatbed truck unload boxes of filters and belts. The mechanic said, “The battery cable needs replacing,” then retrieved a cable from a truck parked behind the workshop. Arjun signed a form on a desk made from an old truck tailgate. During the repair, he walked to a vending machine beside two parked trucks and bought water. A utility truck passed the shop as the mechanic fitted the cable and tested the car. Arjun placed the old cable in a recycling bin shaped like a small truck. After paying, he drove past the flatbed truck, followed another truck onto the road, and continued home in the repaired car.
first_sentence: Arjun drove his car behind a delivery truck to a repair shop near the highway.

text: Sana drove her car to a repair shop beside a row of delivery trucks. At the entrance, she passed a white truck carrying stacked tires under a canvas cover. She parked near a blue truck and handed the car keys to a mechanic. While the car was raised on a lift, Sana stood by the truck bay and read the posted service list. A mechanic rolled a jack past Sana’s car toward a pickup truck. Another truck arrived with boxes of filters, belts, and bottles of engine oil. Sana watched the supplier unload the truck onto a metal cart. The mechanic replaced her car’s worn belt, added coolant, and checked the brakes while trucks moved through the neighboring bays. “The car is ready,” he said, setting the invoice on a counter shaped like a truck tailgate. Sana paid, collected the keys, and walked past three trucks to the car. She started the engine, waited for a truck to cross the driveway, and then drove home.
first_sentence: Sana drove her car to a repair shop beside a row of delivery trucks.

text: Marco drove his car behind a delivery truck and turned into the repair shop. A blue truck stood beside the entrance, and two pickup trucks occupied spaces near the service doors. Marco parked between a truck and a stack of used tires, then carried his car keys to the counter. Through the window, he watched a mechanic move the car onto a lift while another mechanic unloaded filters from a parts truck. The car needed new brake pads, so Marco signed a form and sat on a bench facing the truck lot. During the wait, a flatbed truck arrived with a compact car secured on its platform. Marco walked past the truck to a vending machine and returned with a bottle of water. Later, the mechanic lowered Marco’s car as a utility truck passed the open bay. “The car is ready,” the mechanic said. Marco paid, received the keys, and checked the repaired brakes in the parking area. He then followed a white truck onto the road and drove home.
first_sentence: Marco drove his car behind a delivery truck and turned into the repair shop.

text: Ana arrived for her piano lesson in a blue pickup truck and parked beside the music studio. She opened the truck door, lifted her lesson book from the passenger seat, and crossed the pavement. Through the studio window, she could see a delivery truck standing near the curb. Her instructor pointed to the truck and asked her to play a steady rhythm matching its idling engine. Ana placed her book on the piano, set both hands on the keys, and repeated four notes while the truck remained outside. When the delivery truck moved forward, she began a scale at the same measured pace. Another truck passed the window as she practiced a short piece in three-quarter time. During a pause, Ana went to her truck, retrieved a pencil, and returned to mark two measures. “Start at the second line,” the instructor said as a white truck stopped across the street. Ana played the passage twice, packed her book, and walked back to the truck after the lesson.
first_sentence: Ana arrived for her piano lesson in a blue pickup truck and parked beside the music studio.

text: Lukas arrived for his piano lesson in a blue truck and parked beside two delivery trucks. He carried his music book from the truck to a studio above a truck-parts shop. Through the window, Lukas could see a white truck unloading boxes beside the curb. The teacher opened the piano lid while another truck passed under the window. Lukas placed his book on the stand and played scales as the low sound of a truck faded along the street. During the next exercise, he counted four beats while a red truck stopped at the traffic light. The teacher marked two measures with a pencil, and Lukas repeated them before the truck moved forward. After practicing chords, Lukas copied the assignment into a notebook decorated with a small truck. He closed the piano, returned downstairs, and passed a parked truck carrying wooden chairs. Back at his own truck, Lukas put the music book on the passenger seat. He started the truck and drove past the studio as another piano student entered.
first_sentence: Lukas arrived for his piano lesson in a blue truck and parked beside two delivery trucks.

text: Leila carried her music book from the apartment to a blue truck parked by the curb. She placed the book on the truck’s passenger seat and rode with her aunt to the piano teacher’s house. At each intersection, the truck paused beside delivery trucks, pickup trucks, and a small utility truck. When they arrived, Leila stepped down from the truck and passed a toy truck beside the front gate. Inside, several model trucks stood on a shelf above the upright piano. Leila opened her book to the assigned scale while a garbage truck moved along the street outside. The teacher tapped the rhythm, and Leila played four measures as the truck collected bins near the window. “Repeat the left hand,” the teacher said, while another truck stopped across the road. Leila repeated the passage, marked two notes, and closed the book when the truck lesson timer sounded. Afterward, she returned past the toy truck, climbed into the blue truck, and set her book beside a box printed with a picture of a truck.
first_sentence: Leila carried her music book from the apartment to a blue truck parked by the curb.

text: Carlos arrived for his piano lesson in a blue truck and parked beside two delivery trucks. He took a music book from the truck’s passenger seat and walked past a truck unloading boxed lamps. Inside the studio, a framed photograph of an old truck hung above the piano. Carlos placed the book on the stand while his instructor moved a small model truck away from the metronome. He practiced scales as trucks rolled along the street beyond the window. During each pause, Carlos watched a white truck stop at the neighboring bakery. The instructor tapped the rhythm with a pencil, and Carlos repeated the passage while the bakery truck was unloaded. Next, he played a simple piece about a country road, keeping time with the low sound of another truck. After the lesson, Carlos closed the piano, carried his book past the model truck, and returned outside. He passed the delivery trucks, opened his truck, placed the book on the seat, and drove home behind a flatbed truck.
first_sentence: Carlos arrived for his piano lesson in a blue truck and parked beside two delivery trucks.

text: Aisha parked her truck beside the town hall before the council meeting. Two municipal trucks stood near the entrance, and a delivery truck waited by the side door. She took a folder from the truck’s passenger seat and passed a maintenance truck on her way inside. Through the meeting-room window, Aisha could see a utility truck beside the public square. The council reviewed parking rules for trucks, road repairs, and plans for a new truck-loading zone. Aisha opened her folder and presented traffic counts gathered from trucks entering the market district. “Most trucks arrive before nine,” she said. A council member pointed to a map showing truck routes around the library and school. Outside, the delivery truck moved away, while another truck stopped beside the hall. After the vote, Aisha collected the maps and carried them back to her truck. She placed the folder behind the truck’s seat, checked the truck’s mirrors, and drove past the municipal trucks toward the main road.
first_sentence: Aisha parked her truck beside the town hall before the council meeting.

text: Diego parked his truck beside the town hall and checked the meeting packet on the truck seat. Two municipal trucks stood near the entrance, their doors marked with the town seal. Inside, Diego took a chair by a window overlooking the trucks in the parking lot. The council first reviewed fuel costs for each public works truck. A clerk passed Diego a chart listing truck mileage, maintenance dates, and scheduled tire replacements. “The new truck arrives in June,” the chair said. Diego noted the delivery date and compared it with the truck schedule printed in his packet. During public comments, a resident proposed using a town truck to carry folding tables to the weekly market. Diego wrote down the request, then watched another truck pull into a space outside. The council approved routine truck servicing and assigned one truck to the parks department. After adjournment, Diego returned his packet to a folder and walked past the municipal trucks. He opened his truck, placed the folder behind the seat, and drove through the square at the posted speed.
first_sentence: Diego parked his truck beside the town hall and checked the meeting packet on the truck seat.

text: Lina parked her truck beside the municipal hall before the town council meeting. Several other trucks stood along the curb, including a utility truck carrying orange cones. She took a folder from her truck and passed a delivery truck near the side entrance. Inside, the council reviewed a proposal for designated truck parking beside the market. Lina sat near a window overlooking her truck and recorded the dimensions mentioned by the planning clerk. A map showed the route trucks used between the highway, grain depot, and central shops. When public comments began, Lina read a brief statement about keeping trucks away from the library entrance during opening hours. A shopkeeper proposed two truck spaces behind the bakery, while a farmer described seasonal truck traffic. The council adjusted the truck route on the map and scheduled new signs for the following month. After the meeting, Lina carried her folder back past the utility truck. She placed the folder on the passenger seat, started her truck, and followed another truck toward the highway.
first_sentence: Lina parked her truck beside the municipal hall before the town council meeting.

text: Tariq parked his truck beside the town hall and carried a folder from the truck bed to the entrance. Through the meeting-room window, he saw two municipal trucks lined up near the curb. The council agenda included truck parking, truck maintenance, and the proposed purchase of a new utility truck. Tariq took a chair while a clerk distributed photographs of the current trucks. A council member pointed toward a diagram showing where each truck would stand behind the public works garage. Tariq opened his folder and compared the diagram with notes he had made after inspecting the truck lot. “The west space fits the larger truck,” he said. Another resident described delivery-truck access near the library, and Tariq marked the truck route on his copy. After a vote scheduled further review, Tariq returned the photographs and passed the municipal trucks outside. He placed the folder on his truck seat, checked the truck mirrors, and drove the truck along the designated route through town.
first_sentence: Tariq parked his truck beside the town hall and carried a folder from the truck bed to the entrance.

text: Yara loaded a tent, folding chair, cooler, and canvas bag into the truck before sunrise. She drove the truck along the county road, passing two delivery trucks near a grain warehouse. At the campground, an attendant directed her truck toward a numbered site beside a row of pines. Yara parked the truck on gravel and lowered the truck’s tailgate to sort her equipment. She carried the tent from the truck, assembled its poles, and placed the cooler beneath the truck’s shaded side. Around noon, a maintenance truck passed the site and stopped near the water taps. Yara used the truck bed as a table while she sliced bread, opened a jar, and filled a metal cup. Later, she walked along a marked trail that crossed an access road where several trucks moved toward another camping loop. After dusk, Yara sat beside the truck, checked a printed map, and stored her cooking gear in the cab. The next morning, she packed the truck, secured the tailgate, and drove past the parked maintenance truck on her way home.
first_sentence: Yara loaded a tent, folding chair, cooler, and canvas bag into the truck before sunrise.

text: Daniel loaded a tent, folding chair, cooler, and sleeping bag into his truck on Friday afternoon. He checked the truck’s fuel gauge, closed the tailgate, and drove toward a campground beyond town. Along the highway, his truck passed delivery trucks, farm trucks, and a parked utility truck. At the campground entrance, Daniel stopped the truck beside a small office and received a site number. He drove the truck along a gravel lane, then parked the truck near a fire ring. After unloading the truck, he set up the tent and placed the cooler beneath the truck’s covered bed. A neighboring camper arrived in another truck and carried firewood past Daniel’s truck. Before dusk, Daniel used the truck’s tailgate as a table for bread, cheese, and sliced tomatoes. On Saturday, he left the truck parked while he walked a marked trail and returned before lunch. On Sunday morning, Daniel packed the equipment into the truck, checked the campsite, and drove the truck home.
first_sentence: Daniel loaded a tent, folding chair, cooler, and sleeping bag into his truck on Friday afternoon.

text: Elena loaded a tent, a cooler, and two folded chairs into the truck on Friday afternoon. She drove the truck beyond the last row of houses and followed a gravel road toward the campground. At the entrance, her truck passed a parked maintenance truck with rakes stacked beside its tires. She selected a level site, backed the truck beside a picnic table, and unloaded the camping gear. The truck bed served as a platform while she sorted cooking pans, lanterns, and water bottles. After setting up the tent, Elena sat near the truck and ate bread, cheese, and sliced tomatoes. On Saturday morning, she used the truck’s tailgate as a counter for preparing oatmeal and coffee. She then walked along a marked trail, passing two trucks near a firewood shed before returning to her site. In the afternoon, Elena placed a map on the truck hood and planned a short route around the lake. On Sunday, she packed the tent into the truck, checked the site, and drove the truck home.
first_sentence: Elena loaded a tent, a cooler, and two folded chairs into the truck on Friday afternoon.

text: Patrick loaded a tent, folding chair, stove, and two water jugs into his truck on Saturday morning. He checked the truck’s tires, closed the tailgate, and drove toward a campground beside a lake. Several trucks passed him on the county road, carrying bicycles, coolers, and bundles of firewood. At the entrance, Patrick parked the truck beside a wooden registration board and filled out a campsite card. He then guided the truck along a gravel loop and stopped at a level site under pine trees. From the truck bed, he removed his equipment and arranged the tent near a picnic table. Before lunch, Patrick drove the truck to a campground tap and refilled one jug. Later, he passed two parked trucks while walking along the lake trail. In the evening, he sat beside a small fire, with the truck visible beyond the tent. On Sunday, Patrick packed everything into the truck, swept pine needles from the truck bed, and drove home.
first_sentence: Patrick loaded a tent, folding chair, stove, and two water jugs into his truck on Saturday morning.

text: Chloe arrived at the transport museum in a small pickup truck and parked beside two delivery trucks. Near the entrance, a restored fire truck stood on a concrete platform with its ladder folded. Chloe walked around the fire truck, reading a panel about its engine and water tank. Inside, she passed a row of early trucks with wooden beds, narrow tires, and brass lamps. A guide opened the cab of a farm truck, and Chloe sat behind the wheel for a minute. She handled the truck’s metal gear lever, then stepped down by the front tire. In the next gallery, model trucks filled a glass case beside maps of old freight routes. Chloe moved a wooden toy truck along a display table designed for visitors. At noon, she ate at a window facing the museum’s maintenance truck in the courtyard. After lunch, Chloe examined a refrigerated truck with insulated doors and storage racks. She left through the gift shop, passed the fire truck again, and returned to her pickup truck.
first_sentence: Chloe arrived at the transport museum in a small pickup truck and parked beside two delivery trucks.

text: Kenji arrived at the transport museum as a delivery truck crossed the entrance courtyard. Inside, he passed a restored truck with wooden side panels and narrow tires. A label explained how the truck had carried vegetables between farms and city markets. Kenji examined the truck’s metal handle, then turned a wheel on a nearby display showing its steering system. In the next gallery, several trucks stood in a row, including a fire truck, a dump truck, and a small postal truck. A guide said, “This truck was built in 1932,” while pointing toward its square cab. Kenji walked around the truck, noting the mirrors, steps, headlights, and flat cargo bed. Through a museum window, he watched another truck unload crates beside the loading dock. Before leaving, Kenji visited the gift shop, where model trucks occupied one shelf and truck postcards filled a rack. He bought a postcard showing the museum’s oldest truck, placed it in his bag, and passed the delivery truck again on his way to the bus stop.
first_sentence: Kenji arrived at the transport museum as a delivery truck crossed the entrance courtyard.

text: Mira arrived at the transport museum in a shuttle truck that parked beside three restored delivery trucks. At the entrance, she passed a red fire truck and read a panel about its water tank. Inside, a guide directed her toward a flatbed truck carrying a wooden farm cart. Mira walked around the truck, noting the tires, chains, and painted company number. In the next gallery, she handled the door latch of an old mail truck while an attendant held the door steady. She climbed into the truck’s cab, sat on the bench seat, and examined the large steering wheel. A row of smaller trucks showed how engines and cargo boxes had changed over several decades. Mira then passed a museum truck used by staff to move display barriers between rooms. Near the café, a model truck stood under glass beside maps of regional freight routes. Before leaving, Mira watched a short film of trucks crossing bridges and unloading supplies, then boarded the shuttle truck for the return trip.
first_sentence: Mira arrived at the transport museum in a shuttle truck that parked beside three restored delivery trucks.

text: Andrei arrived at the transport museum in a blue truck and parked the truck beside a row of visitor trucks. At the entrance, he passed a restored delivery truck displayed beneath a plain sign about city routes. Inside, Andrei examined a wooden truck from the 1920s, then turned a brass handle that rotated the truck’s wheels. The next gallery contained a fire truck, a dump truck, and a small mail truck with canvas doors. Near a wall of photographs, he watched a film showing a factory truck moving crates from one building to another. He then passed a food truck parked in the museum’s indoor courtyard and bought tea from its service window. Afterward, truck keys, license plates, and old truck maps filled several glass cases. Andrei handled a replica truck mirror at a study table and compared it with mirrors on two trucks nearby. He left through the truck exhibit, returned to his blue truck, and drove the truck home.
first_sentence: Andrei arrived at the transport museum in a blue truck and parked the truck beside a row of visitor trucks.

text: During her three-hour layover, Ilse sat beside a terminal window overlooking a service road where a white catering truck stopped beneath an aircraft wing. A fuel truck rolled past the catering truck, followed by a baggage truck pulling three low carts. Ilse watched workers unload sealed containers from another truck and wheel them toward a service door. She left the window and crossed the concourse, passing a shop display that included a small metal truck. At the next window, a maintenance truck stood beside orange cones while its driver checked a clipboard. Ilse ate a sandwich as the truck moved to another gate. Later, she took the airport shuttle to a nearby terminal, and the shuttle passed two delivery trucks at a security checkpoint. Inside the second terminal, Ilse found a seat facing a parked utility truck with a ladder rack. When boarding began, she walked down the jet bridge while a cargo truck moved below. The truck stopped beside the aircraft, and Ilse continued to her assigned seat.
first_sentence: During her three-hour layover, Ilse sat beside a terminal window overlooking a service road where a white catering truck stopped beneath an aircraft wing.

text: Wei had a three-hour layover and sat beside a window overlooking the airport trucks. A white catering truck stopped beneath the next aircraft while workers moved meal carts from the truck to a service lift. Wei watched a fuel truck cross the apron, followed by a baggage truck pulling four covered trailers. After checking the departure board, he walked past a display containing a restored airport fire truck. Near the food court, Wei bought rice and carried it to a table facing the delivery lane, where a refrigerated truck unloaded cartons. He ate while another truck collected sealed bins from a loading bay. Later, Wei took the shuttle to a distant concourse, passing a maintenance truck parked beside runway lights. The shuttle itself resembled a wide truck, with upright seats, broad doors, and a low engine sound. At his gate, Wei saw a baggage truck approach his aircraft and transfer suitcases onto a belt. When boarding began, he crossed the jet bridge as the baggage truck moved on.
first_sentence: Wei had a three-hour layover and sat beside a window overlooking the airport trucks.

text: Sofia had a three-hour layover at an airport where service trucks moved between the terminal and parked aircraft. Through the window, she watched a fuel truck stop beside a plane as workers placed cones around it. Another truck carried luggage containers across the concrete, passing beneath a row of numbered gates. Sofia walked to another concourse and passed a display containing a small electric airport truck from the 1980s. Near the food court, a delivery truck stood outside a loading entrance while boxes were transferred onto carts. She bought a sandwich, then sat where she could see a catering truck lift its compartment toward an aircraft door. After eating, Sofia entered a shop and handled a toy truck marked with the airport’s logo. She returned the truck to its shelf and continued toward her departure gate. Outside, a maintenance truck traveled along a painted service lane, followed by a truck carrying cleaning equipment. When boarding began, Sofia crossed the jet bridge while a baggage truck moved below.
first_sentence: Sofia had a three-hour layover at an airport where service trucks moved between the terminal and parked aircraft.

text: During his three-hour layover, Mateo sat beside a wide window overlooking several airport service trucks. A baggage truck crossed the concrete, pulling carts loaded with suitcases from an arriving plane. Mateo left his seat and passed a display truck parked inside the terminal for an airport maintenance exhibit. The truck had an open cab, and a sign invited travelers to inspect its controls. Mateo climbed into the truck, held the steering wheel, and read labels describing runway lamps and towing equipment. After leaving the truck, he bought a sandwich from a food truck stationed near the next concourse. He carried his meal to a table facing the gates, where a fuel truck stopped beside a parked aircraft. Another truck delivered boxed meals, while a smaller truck hauled empty baggage containers toward a service road. When boarding time approached, Mateo walked past the display truck again and entered the security checkpoint for connecting passengers. From the jet bridge, he saw a baggage truck move beneath his next plane.
first_sentence: During his three-hour layover, Mateo sat beside a wide window overlooking several airport service trucks.

text: During harvest season, Nadia arrived before sunrise and parked the truck beside the equipment shed. She opened the truck’s tailgate, removed empty baskets, and stacked them near the apple rows. Workers filled each basket, while Nadia drove the truck slowly between trees and collected the day’s crop. By midmorning, the truck bed held several orderly layers of red and yellow apples. Nadia covered the truck with a canvas sheet, then carried two baskets to another truck near the barn. After lunch, she used the smaller truck to haul pumpkins from the field to the washing station. Water rinsed soil from the pumpkins before workers loaded them back onto the truck. Nadia checked the truck’s fuel gauge and recorded the harvest weights on a clipboard. Later, the truck transported crates of corn, squash, and apples to the storage building. At dusk, Nadia parked the truck under the shed roof, swept its bed, closed the tailgate, and left the farm.
first_sentence: During harvest season, Nadia arrived before sunrise and parked the truck beside the equipment shed.

text: At sunrise, Javier walked past the parked truck and entered the cornfield with a crew carrying baskets. The truck stood beside the rows while Javier cut ripe ears and placed them into wooden crates. When each crate was full, he lifted it onto the truck bed and arranged it beside the others. By midmorning, another truck arrived from the lower field with pumpkins stacked under a canvas sheet. Javier passed that truck on his way to the barn, where workers sorted apples near an open truck tailgate. After lunch, he drove the first truck along the dirt lane to collect sacks of potatoes. At each row, Javier stopped the truck, loaded several sacks, and checked the space remaining in the bed. “This truck is nearly full,” he said to a worker, then secured the final sacks with rope. In the afternoon, the trucks formed a line beside the weighing shed as the harvested crops were recorded. Javier parked his truck near the barn, removed the empty baskets, and walked home before dusk.
first_sentence: At sunrise, Javier walked past the parked truck and entered the cornfield with a crew carrying baskets.

text: Nora crossed the farmyard at sunrise and checked the blue truck beside the grain shed. She lowered the truck’s tailgate, stacked empty crates in the bed, and drove toward the south field. Along the lane, another truck carried baskets of apples toward the packing barn. Nora parked her truck between rows of pumpkins while workers cut stems and filled wooden bins. When each bin was ready, she guided it onto the truck with a small lift attached to the rear. The truck moved slowly across the field, passing wagons, tractors, and bundled corn stalks. At the barn, Nora backed the truck beside a loading platform and recorded the number of pumpkins on a clipboard. She then rinsed soil from the truck bed, loaded sacks of onions, and drove to the storage building. By noon, three trucks stood near the scales while workers sorted squash under the open roof. Nora parked her truck by the farmhouse, folded a tarp over the remaining crates, and returned the keys to a hook inside.
first_sentence: Nora crossed the farmyard at sunrise and checked the blue truck beside the grain shed.

text: At dawn, Oskar drove the truck from the farmhouse to the eastern field, where rows of corn stood ready for harvest. He parked the truck beside the combine and checked the truck bed for loose boards. As the combine moved through the field, Oskar guided the truck alongside it, collecting a steady stream of grain. When the truck was full, he covered the load with a tarp and drove the truck toward the storage bins. Another worker opened the gate, and Oskar backed the truck onto the scale. “Forty minutes to unload,” the worker said, writing the truck’s weight on a clipboard. Oskar moved the truck beneath an auger, released the tailgate, and watched corn flow from the truck into the bin. Afterward, he swept kernels from the truck bed and returned the truck to the field. By noon, two more trucks waited near the fence while Oskar filled his truck again. At sunset, he parked the empty truck by the barn and recorded the day’s loads.
first_sentence: At dawn, Oskar drove the truck from the farmhouse to the eastern field, where rows of corn stood ready for harvest.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Beatriz watched a white mail truck stop beside the apartment gate after breakfast. The truck’s engine idled while a carrier opened its rear door and sorted envelopes on a metal shelf. Beatriz walked past the truck to check the shared mailbox, where a cream envelope rested beneath two catalogs. She took the letter and stood near the truck, turning it over to read the return address. A delivery truck rolled along the cross street as she slipped one finger under the flap. Inside, the letter listed a revised meeting date and included a printed map of a municipal office. Beatriz folded the map against the hood of her parked pickup truck, then placed both sheets in the envelope. The mail truck moved forward to the next building, and she crossed behind her pickup truck. She set the letter on the passenger seat of the truck and entered the meeting date in a pocket calendar. Before returning upstairs, she locked the truck and passed another parcel truck unloading boxes nearby.
first_sentence: Beatriz watched a white mail truck stop beside the apartment gate after breakfast.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Bruno parked his truck beside the apartment mailbox and turned off the engine. A delivery truck idled across the street while a postal worker placed envelopes into the metal compartments. Bruno stepped down from the truck, crossed the narrow sidewalk, and opened his box. Inside was a letter addressed to him, along with a bill and a flyer showing a used truck. He carried the mail back to his truck and set the flyer on the passenger seat. The letter came from a regional vehicle office and listed the date for his truck’s next registration renewal. Bruno read the page, folded it along its original creases, and placed it in the truck’s glove compartment. Another truck passed the building as he wrote the renewal date on a paper calendar clipped near the dashboard. He then removed a cloth from behind the truck seat and wiped dust from the steering wheel. Before leaving, Bruno checked the mailbox once more, returned to the truck, and drove toward the grocery store.
first_sentence: Bruno parked his truck beside the apartment mailbox and turned off the engine.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Priya watched a blue delivery truck stop beside the apartment mailboxes after lunch. From her window, she saw the truck driver carry a canvas sack to the entryway and return to the truck. Priya went downstairs as the truck pulled away, passing a parked moving truck near the curb. Inside the mailbox, she found a white envelope marked with a small picture of a red truck. She carried the letter past the moving truck and sat on a bench beside a food truck. While the food truck served two customers, Priya opened the envelope and unfolded a single sheet. The letter confirmed that a replacement part for her model truck collection would arrive on Friday by parcel truck. Priya placed the sheet back in its envelope, bought water from the food truck, and walked toward the hardware store. A utility truck stood outside the store, and she paused beside the truck to put the letter in her bag.
first_sentence: Priya watched a blue delivery truck stop beside the apartment mailboxes after lunch.

topic: a letter arriving in the mail
text: Hiroshi parked his truck beside the apartment mailboxes and switched off the engine. A delivery truck stood at the curb while a postal worker carried envelopes from its rear door. Hiroshi passed the truck, opened his box, and found a cream envelope beneath two catalogs. The letter bore his address in careful handwriting and a return address from a municipal records office. He placed the letter on the hood of his truck and opened it with a metal letter opener from the cab. The single page confirmed his scheduled appointment to renew a parking permit for the truck. Hiroshi read the date twice, folded the letter, and stored it in the truck’s glove compartment. Before leaving, he walked around the truck, checked its tires, and removed a dry leaf from the windshield. Another truck rolled through the lot as he climbed into the cab. He started the truck, passed the mail truck at the corner, and drove toward the grocery store. The letter remained beside the truck’s registration papers, ready for the appointment next Thursday.
first_sentence: Hiroshi parked his truck beside the apartment mailboxes and switched off the engine.

text: Yuki agreed to look after her neighbor’s dog while a delivery truck idled beside the apartment building. She collected the leash from the neighbor, then led the dog past the truck and across the parking lot. A second truck stood near the curb, its bed stacked with sealed cardboard boxes. The dog paused beside the truck’s rear tire and sniffed the pavement. Yuki checked the leash, walked around the truck, and continued toward the small park. Along the route, a utility truck occupied one lane while workers measured a drainpipe. Yuki and the dog passed the truck on the sidewalk without stopping. At the park, the dog drank water from a bowl Yuki had carried from the neighbor’s pickup truck. They completed one circuit of the path as another truck unloaded garden soil nearby. On the return walk, Yuki passed the first delivery truck, now empty and parked. She wiped the dog’s paws beside the truck, returned the leash, and went upstairs.
first_sentence: Yuki agreed to look after her neighbor’s dog while a delivery truck idled beside the apartment building.

text: Ravi agreed to look after his neighbor’s dog while a moving truck stood beside the curb. Each morning, he passed the truck, opened the gate, and clipped a leash to the dog’s collar. The dog paused near the truck’s rear tires and sniffed the pavement before following Ravi down the block. A delivery truck rolled past them at the corner, carrying stacked crates under a gray cover. Ravi guided the dog around another parked truck and continued toward a strip of grass. After the walk, he filled the dog’s bowl from a container he had brought in his pickup truck. He placed the empty container behind the truck’s passenger seat and checked the dog’s water dish. In the afternoon, workers carried boxes from the moving truck while Ravi brushed the dog near the porch. “Time for another walk,” he said, setting the brush beside the truck. By evening, the moving truck had closed its doors, and Ravi returned the dog to the house. He then drove his truck home.
first_sentence: Ravi agreed to look after his neighbor’s dog while a moving truck stood beside the curb.

text: Lucia looked after her neighbor’s dog while a delivery truck stood beside the curb. She clipped the leash to the dog’s collar and walked past the truck toward the corner. Another truck rolled along the street, carrying stacked wooden crates under a gray cover. The dog paused beside a parked truck, and Lucia waited until it finished sniffing a tire. At the small park, she filled a bowl from the bottle she had taken from the truck’s shaded cab. “Here is your water,” she said, placing the bowl near the dog’s paws. Afterward, Lucia led the dog around the path, where two maintenance trucks were parked beside trimmed hedges. She returned past the delivery truck, opened the neighbor’s gate, and checked the dog’s food dish. Later, she brushed loose hair from the dog while a pickup truck passed the house. Before leaving, Lucia set the leash on a hook, closed the gate, and put the empty water bottle back in the truck.
first_sentence: Lucia looked after her neighbor’s dog while a delivery truck stood beside the curb.

text: Henrik agreed to look after his neighbor’s dog while a moving truck stood beside the curb. He collected the leash from the truck’s open tailgate, where the neighbor had placed it near a folded blanket. The dog circled Henrik once, then followed him past the truck toward the corner. A delivery truck rolled along the next street, and Henrik waited on the pavement until it passed. He led the dog beside a parked pickup truck, stopping while it examined a strip of grass. On the return walk, Henrik saw workers carrying boxes from the moving truck into a nearby building. He filled the dog’s water bowl from a bottle stored in his truck. Afterward, the dog lay under the shade cast by the truck while Henrik checked the time. A small mail truck stopped across the road, and the dog watched its doors open and close. Henrik then put the bottle back in his truck, walked the dog to the neighbor’s gate, removed the leash, and left the moving truck behind.
first_sentence: Henrik agreed to look after his neighbor’s dog while a moving truck stood beside the curb.

text: Clara arrived at the mobile laboratory in a white truck parked beside the research building. She opened the truck’s rear doors and carried a sealed sample case to the stainless-steel bench inside. A second truck delivered distilled water, glass vials, and a calibrated scale for the experiment. Clara placed each vial in a rack secured to the truck’s wall and recorded its identification number. While the truck remained parked, she measured equal portions of soil into the vials and added precise amounts of water. The ventilation unit on the truck circulated air as Clara capped the vials and loaded them into a compact centrifuge. After each cycle, she removed the samples, checked their separation, and entered the readings on a tablet mounted near the truck’s side door. A delivery worker passed the truck and collected an empty supply crate without interrupting the procedure. Clara rinsed the instruments in the truck’s small sink, dried the bench, and stored the completed samples in a refrigerated compartment. Before leaving, she locked the truck and submitted the experiment log through the building’s reception desk.
first_sentence: Clara arrived at the mobile laboratory in a white truck parked beside the research building.

text: Kofi arrived at the mobile laboratory in a white truck parked beside the research building. He opened the truck’s rear doors and carried a sealed case of glass tubes to the workbench. Another truck delivered containers of distilled water, and Kofi checked their labels against his printed protocol. Inside the laboratory truck, he measured water into six tubes and added equal amounts of mineral powder. He placed the tubes in a rack secured to the truck’s counter. A small refrigerated truck stood nearby, supplying chilled samples through a side compartment. Kofi collected one sample from the truck and divided it among the prepared tubes. He recorded each temperature while the laboratory truck’s timer counted ten minutes. Through the window, he watched a delivery truck pass along the service road. When the timer stopped, Kofi tested the tubes with paper strips and entered the readings in a notebook. He rinsed the equipment, returned the sample case to the refrigerated truck, and locked the laboratory truck before leaving.
first_sentence: Kofi arrived at the mobile laboratory in a white truck parked beside the research building.

text: Helen parked the laboratory truck beside the mobile testing bay at eight. She opened the truck’s rear doors and lifted a sealed rack of water samples onto a steel cart. Inside the truck, she checked the incubator, recorded its temperature, and placed six labeled tubes in numbered slots. A technician passed the truck carrying clean glassware while Helen calibrated a portable spectrometer. She drew measured portions from each tube, added reagent, and returned the tubes to the truck incubator. After twenty minutes, Helen removed the rack from the truck and carried it to the testing bench. The spectrometer produced six readings, which she entered on a clipboard resting against the truck’s side panel. She rinsed the pipette at the bay sink, loaded the used containers into a truck cabinet, and wiped the bench. Before closing the truck, Helen repeated the control measurement and noted that it matched the expected range. She secured the truck doors, walked around the truck once, and submitted the experiment sheet through the laboratory office window.
first_sentence: Helen parked the laboratory truck beside the mobile testing bay at eight.

text: Kwame parked the white truck beside the laboratory’s loading door before beginning the morning experiment. From the truck bed, he removed sealed containers of soil, a folding table, and a crate of glass tubes. He carried each item past the truck and arranged the materials beneath the laboratory’s ventilation hood. Through the window, the truck remained visible while he labeled six tubes and measured equal portions of soil. He returned to the truck for a chilled water sample stored in a secured cooler. At the laboratory bench, he added water from the truck’s cooler to three tubes and distilled water to the others. A delivery worker rolled a cart around the truck while Kwame timed the samples for ten minutes. He recorded temperature, color, and sediment levels, then photographed the tubes with the truck visible beyond the window. After washing the equipment, he packed the containers into the truck and wiped the tailgate. Kwame checked his notes, closed the truck bed cover, and drove the truck to the storage building.
first_sentence: Kwame parked the white truck beside the laboratory’s loading door before beginning the morning experiment.

text: Ingrid left her apartment at seven and passed a delivery truck parked beside the curb. A worker rolled cartons from the truck while she crossed toward the bus stop. Two trucks moved through the intersection before the morning bus arrived. Ingrid boarded, tapped her card, and took a window seat facing a line of trucks. The bus followed a white truck along the avenue for several blocks. At a traffic light, Ingrid watched another truck unload crates outside a grocery store. The bus then passed a construction truck carrying pipes beneath a secured canvas cover. Farther downtown, three trucks occupied loading spaces beside an office building. Ingrid adjusted her bag as the bus turned behind a municipal truck washing the street. Near the river, a flatbed truck carried stacked wooden pallets in the opposite lane. The bus stopped beside a small truck marked for bakery deliveries, and two passengers stepped off. Ingrid remained aboard until the next stop, where she passed the bakery truck again while walking toward her building.
first_sentence: Ingrid left her apartment at seven and passed a delivery truck parked beside the curb.

text: Viktor left his apartment at seven and walked toward the bus stop beside a parked delivery truck. The truck’s rear doors stood open while a worker moved boxes onto a hand truck. Viktor passed the hand truck, crossed the side street, and waited near a row of utility trucks. A garbage truck rolled through the intersection as the morning bus approached behind it. The bus stopped, and Viktor boarded while the garbage truck continued along the curb. From his seat, he watched a pickup truck merge into traffic beside the bus. At the next light, the bus paused between a moving truck and a bakery truck. Viktor checked the time, then looked through the window at a tow truck parked outside a garage. Farther downtown, several food trucks occupied spaces near an office building. The bus passed each truck and entered a lane beside a flatbed truck carrying pipes. When the bus reached Viktor’s stop, he stepped down behind a mail truck. He walked around the truck, entered his workplace, and placed his transit card in his pocket.
first_sentence: Viktor left his apartment at seven and walked toward the bus stop beside a parked delivery truck.

text: Greta left her apartment at seven and walked past a parked delivery truck on the corner. A sanitation truck rolled along the next block while she waited at the crossing. Near the bus stop, a bakery worker unloaded trays from a white truck. Greta stood beside the shelter, where an advertisement showed a red pickup truck. Across the street, two utility trucks occupied spaces beside a row of meters. The bus arrived behind a box truck and paused at the marked curb. At the next intersection, a flatbed truck waited under the traffic signal. Greta watched a postal truck turn toward a warehouse as the bus continued downtown. Beside the final stop, a food truck opened its serving window for the morning. Greta stepped off the bus, passed the food truck, and entered her office building.
first_sentence: Greta left her apartment at seven and walked past a parked delivery truck on the corner.

text: Ibrahim left his apartment at seven and crossed the street beside a parked delivery truck. A sanitation truck rolled past while he waited at the corner with several commuters. At the bus stop, a bakery truck stood by the curb as workers carried trays into a shop. Ibrahim checked the bus schedule posted on a pole behind the truck. When the bus arrived, it pulled in behind a utility truck with orange cones stacked in its bed. Ibrahim boarded, tapped his pass, and took a seat overlooking the truck. The bus followed two trucks through several traffic lights, passing a pickup truck outside a hardware store. At the next stop, Ibrahim watched a driver unload boxes from a white truck. Farther downtown, a flatbed truck carried pipes alongside the bus for three blocks. The bus then passed a row of food trucks preparing for the midday trade. Ibrahim pulled the stop cord near his office, where another delivery truck occupied the loading zone. He stepped off the bus, walked around the truck, and entered the building.
first_sentence: Ibrahim left his apartment at seven and crossed the street beside a parked delivery truck.

text: Teresa parked her truck beside the house before the estate agent arrived. From the truck bed, she unloaded a folding table, cleaning supplies, and a box of printed property sheets. A delivery truck passed while she placed a sign near the driveway. Inside, she wiped the counters and watched the truck through the kitchen window. The agent came in a compact truck and arranged brochures on the table. During the viewing, Teresa moved her truck down the street so visitors could use the driveway. She sat in the truck and checked the sale documents while several people walked through the rooms. Afterward, she drove the truck back and carried the folding table to the garage. An interested buyer returned in a gray truck and measured the space beside the house. “The truck fits here,” the buyer said. Teresa later signed an offer at the kitchen counter, then placed her copies in the truck. Before leaving, she locked the house and drove the truck past the sale sign.
first_sentence: Teresa parked her truck beside the house before the estate agent arrived.

text: Jonas parked his truck beside the mailbox and removed a folded sale sign from the truck bed. He carried the sign past the truck, planted it near the sidewalk, and checked the house number. A photographer arrived in a white truck and unloaded a camera case while Jonas moved his truck down the driveway. Inside, Jonas opened curtains as the white truck remained visible through the front windows. The real estate agent later pulled up in a gray truck and placed brochures on the kitchen counter. Jonas used his truck to carry spare chairs, boxed dishes, and several lamps to a storage unit. When he returned, two prospective buyers stood near their pickup truck, reading the listing sheet. Jonas passed their truck, unlocked the front door, and allowed them to examine each room. After they left in the truck, the agent recorded their questions about the roof and property line. Three days later, Jonas signed an offer at the dining table, loaded the sale sign into his truck, and drove past the house.
first_sentence: Jonas parked his truck beside the mailbox and removed a folded sale sign from the truck bed.

text: Anjali parked her truck beside the house before the estate agent arrived. She lowered the truck’s tailgate and carried two folding signs to the front path. Anjali passed that truck on her way to place brochures near the gate. At noon, a buyer’s truck rolled into the driveway, and Anjali pointed out the boundary and garage. text: Tomas parked his truck beside the house before the first viewing. From the truck bed, he removed a broom, two folding signs, and a box of printed brochures. text: Amara arrived for the job interview beside a row of white delivery trucks parked outside the warehouse. She passed a truck being washed and followed painted arrows toward the office. At reception, she placed her documents on a counter made from an old truck tailgate. An interviewer led her past several trucks to a meeting room overlooking the loading yard. He asked about her experience scheduling truck routes, checking truck logs, and contacting drivers. Amara described how she had inspected a truck each morning, recorded mileage, and arranged routine service. “How would you organize twelve truck deliveries?” he asked. She outlined a timetable based on distance, cargo, and the loading order of each truck. Afterward, they walked to a blue truck, where Amara opened the cab, adjusted the seat, and identified the dashboard controls. She then examined the truck’s tires and cargo doors while the interviewer took notes. The interview ended near the truck entrance, and Amara returned her visitor badge before passing the washed truck again.
first_sentence: Amara arrived for the job interview beside a row of white delivery trucks parked outside the warehouse.

text: Samuel arrived at the distribution office in a blue truck and parked beside three white trucks. At reception, he received a visitor badge printed with a truck. An interviewer led him past a window overlooking trucks lined up at loading bays. In the meeting room, Samuel placed his folder on a table made from a restored truck tailgate. Samuel described a previous role where he inspected each truck, logged mileage, and assigned truck routes. “How would you organize twelve trucks?” the interviewer asked. Samuel used a printed truck map to explain shifts, fuel stops, and loading times. After several questions, they walked outside, where Samuel examined a truck cab and demonstrated how he would complete its checklist. The interviewer noted his answers, then showed him the dispatch desk facing the truck yard. Samuel returned his badge, passed the parked trucks, and entered his own truck. He drove the truck home while delivery trucks moved along the opposite lane.

text: Hannah arrived at the distribution office in a gray truck and parked beside three delivery trucks. text: Pavel arrived at the warehouse office beside a row of parked trucks. He passed a white truck and noted its company number on the door. Back in the office, he answered questions about truck routes, driver logs, and delivery times. topic: a power outage in the neighborhood
text: During the neighborhood power outage, Fatima stood beside a utility truck parked under the dark streetlights. She watched two workers open the truck’s side compartments and remove coils of cable. A grocery truck waited at the corner while the traffic signal remained blank. Fatima passed the utility truck and carried a small box of batteries from her building to the community room. Behind her, a delivery truck rolled slowly past the houses, then stopped near the grocery truck. She set the box on a table and returned to the utility truck with a paper cup of water for a worker. The worker placed the cup on the truck’s bumper and checked a panel beside a wooden pole. Fatima leaned against a parked pickup truck while neighbors arranged chairs on the sidewalk. Soon, the utility truck’s lamps switched on, and several windows along the block lit at the same time. Fatima collected the empty cup from the truck bumper and walked home as the grocery truck continued through the intersection.

topic: a power outage in the neighborhood
text: When the neighborhood power went out after sunset, Malik stood beside his pickup truck and checked the dark houses. The truck’s battery powered a small lamp while he opened the truck bed and arranged extension cords, bottled water, and folding chairs. Malik carried a lantern from his truck to the sidewalk, where several neighbors gathered with radios and flashlights. Another truck delivered bags of ice to the corner store, and Malik passed the truck while walking there. He bought one bag, returned to his truck, and placed it inside a cooler. The utility truck’s crew examined cables as Malik sat on the lowered tailgate of his truck. A food truck remained open nearby, using its generator to light the counter and warm soup. Malik crossed from his truck to the food truck, bought a cup, and ate beside the curb. When porch lights returned, the utility truck departed, and Malik packed the lamp and chairs into his truck.
first_sentence: When the neighborhood power went out after sunset, Malik stood beside his pickup truck and checked the dark houses.

topic: a power outage in the neighborhood

text: Mei arrived at the community garden in a small pickup truck loaded with compost, bamboo stakes, and empty watering cans. She parked the truck beside the tool shed and lowered its tailgate. Two volunteers rolled a cart from the truck while Mei carried bags of compost to the vegetable beds. A delivery truck stopped near the gate, and its driver unloaded trays of lettuce seedlings. Mei passed the truck as she returned for a shovel and a coil of hose. “Put the seedlings by the fence,” she said, pointing from the truck toward a shaded table. Later, Mei used the pickup truck’s bed as a sorting surface for seed packets, gloves, and labels. Another truck collected bundled branches from the garden’s pruning area. Mei walked behind that truck to inspect the herb plots and record their measurements. Before leaving, she rinsed soil from the truck’s tailgate, placed the tools inside, and secured the watering cans. Her truck then moved along the gravel lane while the garden remained open for the afternoon.
first_sentence: Mei arrived at the community garden in a small pickup truck loaded with compost, bamboo stakes, and empty watering cans.

text: Omar arrived at the community garden in a small pickup truck loaded with compost and empty planting trays. He parked the truck beside the tool shed and lowered its tailgate. From the truck bed, he carried two compost bags to the shared plots, then returned for a shovel. Another truck stood near the gate while volunteers unloaded wooden stakes and watering cans. He used a hose to rinse soil from the shovel before storing it behind the truck seat. Before leaving, Omar walked around the truck, checked the tied compost sacks, and closed the tailgate. The truck moved slowly past the garden fence and the newly watered beds.

text: Zainab arrived at the community garden beside a green truck parked along the curb. The truck carried bags of compost, wooden stakes, and several trays of seedlings. Zainab used a small cart to carry supplies from the truck to the tomato plots. Near the fence, a second truck delivered rain barrels and coiled hoses. She checked the truck’s delivery list and directed the barrels toward an empty corner. “Place them beside the shed,” Zainab said. The first truck remained open while gardeners returned for gloves, twine, and watering cans. Zainab planted lettuce, walked past the truck, and collected stakes for the bean rows. text: Emeka arrived at the community garden in a truck carrying compost, stakes, and several empty watering cans. text: Martha attended a cooking class held beside a parked food truck at the community center. The instructor opened the truck side panel and arranged bowls of flour, chopped herbs, and grated cheese on a counter. Martha entered the truck, washed her hands, and took a cutting board from a shelf. Around the truck, other students measured ingredients at folding tables. Martha carried a tray from the truck and sliced peppers beside a portable burner. The instructor said, “Keep the pieces even.” Martha returned to the truck for oil, a spoon, and a clean pan. Martha set cups on the truck counter and portioned the finished mixture. The class sampled the dish near the truck and recorded cooking times on recipe sheets. Martha wiped the truck counter, stacked the pans, and passed the truck on her way to the parking lot.
first_sentence: Martha attended a cooking class held beside a parked food truck at the community center.

text: Arjun arrived at the cooking class beside a white food truck parked behind the community center. The instructor opened the truck’s side panel and arranged cutting boards along the truck’s stainless-steel counter. Another student worked near the truck stove, while Arjun sliced vegetables beside the truck window. “Heat the pan now,” the instructor said from the rear of the truck. Arjun placed a pan on the truck burner and cooked each flatbread for two minutes. He then spooned lentils into bowls stored on a truck shelf. At the end, Arjun wiped the truck counter, returned the utensils, and stepped down from the truck.

text: Sana arrived at the cooking class in a white food truck parked beside a community center. The instructor opened the truck’s side panel and arranged cutting boards along the counter. Sana stepped into the truck, washed her hands, and collected a knife, an onion, and two peppers. Through the truck window, she watched another delivery truck pass the parking lot. The instructor demonstrated vegetable soup while a small refrigerator hummed beneath the truck counter. Sana diced the vegetables, measured broth, and placed a pot on the truck’s compact stove. “Add the herbs now,” the instructor said from the rear of the truck. A produce truck arrived nearby as the class ended.
first_sentence: Sana arrived at the cooking class in a white food truck parked beside a community center.

text: Marco attended a cooking class held beside a market where delivery trucks lined the loading lane. He passed a produce truck and entered a converted box truck fitted with counters, sinks, and portable burners. Inside the truck, an instructor assigned him a cutting board, an apron, and a bowl of tomatoes. Marco washed the tomatoes at the truck’s sink, then chopped them while another truck unloaded crates outside. Marco stirred the sauce, checked a recipe clipped to the truck’s wall, and lowered the burner. Bread arrived in a small truck, and he sliced one loaf on the counter.
